const SCREEN_TITLES = {
  dashboard:'Painel Geral', estoque:'Estoque', mov:'Movimentações',
  cats:'Categorias', alertas:'Alertas & Config.', insights:'Insights',
  lista:'Lista de Compras', relatorios:'Relatórios'
};

function showScreen(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('screen-'+name).classList.add('active');

  document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar .nav-item').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));
  const sn=document.getElementById('nav-'+name);
  if(sn) sn.classList.add('active');

  document.querySelectorAll('.bottom-nav .nav-item').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));
  const mn=document.getElementById('nav-'+name+'-mob');
  if(mn) mn.classList.add('active');

  const ttl=document.getElementById('topbarTitle');
  if(ttl) ttl.textContent=SCREEN_TITLES[name]||name;

  S.screen=name;
  document.getElementById('mainScroll').scrollTop=0;
  closeMobileSidebar();

  updateListaBadge();
  const renders={
    dashboard:renderDashboard,estoque:renderEstoque,
    mov:renderMovs,cats:renderCats,
    alertas:renderAlertas,insights:renderInsightsAndPrevisao,
    lista:renderLista,relatorios:renderRelatorios
  };
  if(renders[name]) renders[name]();
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// SIDEBAR CONTROLS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function toggleSidebar(){
  const sb=document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const collapsed=sb.classList.contains('collapsed');
  _positionHandle(collapsed);
  localStorage.setItem('sbCollapsed', collapsed?'1':'0');
}

function _positionHandle(collapsed){
  const handle=document.getElementById('sbHandle');
  if(!handle) return;
  const w = collapsed ? 64 : 230;
  handle.style.left = w + 'px';
  handle.setAttribute('data-tip', collapsed ? 'Expandir' : 'Recolher');
  handle.classList.toggle('collapsed', collapsed);
}

function openMobileSidebar(){
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('mobile-open');
  document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.add('visible');
}
function closeMobileSidebar(){
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('mobile-open');

// SIDEBAR CONTROLS
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function toggleSidebar(){
  const sb=document.getElementById('sidebar');
  sb.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const collapsed=sb.classList.contains('collapsed');
  _positionHandle(collapsed);
  localStorage.setItem('sbCollapsed', collapsed?'1':'0');
}

function _positionHandle(collapsed){
  const handle=document.getElementById('sbHandle');
  if(!handle) return;
  const w = collapsed ? 64 : 230;
  handle.style.left = w + 'px';
  handle.setAttribute('data-tip', collapsed ? 'Expandir' : 'Recolher');
  handle.classList.toggle('collapsed', collapsed);
}

function openMobileSidebar(){
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('mobile-open');
  document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.add('visible');
}
function closeMobileSidebar(){
  document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.remove('mobile-open');
  document.getElementById('sidebarOverlay').classList.remove('visible');
}

function toggleFaq(qEl){
  const item=qEl.closest('.faq-item');
  const wasOpen=item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('open'));
  if(!wasOpen) item.classList.add('open');
}

let _relTab = 'estoque';
const _charts = {};

function setRelTab(name, btn){
  _relTab = name;
  document.querySelectorAll('#rtEstoque,#rtMovs,#rtFinanceiro').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('relTabEstoque').style.display    = name==='estoque'    ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('relTabMovs').style.display       = name==='movs'       ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('relTabFinanceiro').style.display = name==='financeiro'  ? '' : 'none';
  setTimeout(()=>_renderRelTab(name), 60);
}

function renderRelatorios(){
  _relTab = 'estoque';
  ['rtEstoque','rtMovs','rtFinanceiro'].forEach((id,i)=>{
    const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.classList.toggle('active',i===0);
  });
  document.getElementById('relTabEstoque').style.display    = '';
  document.getElementById('relTabMovs').style.display       = 'none';
  document.getElementById('relTabFinanceiro').style.display = 'none';
  setTimeout(()=>_renderRelTab('estoque'), 100);
}

function _renderRelTab(tab){
  if(tab==='estoque')    _renderRelEstoque();
  if(tab==='movs')       _renderRelMovs();
  if(tab==='financeiro') _renderRelFinanceiro();
}

function monthStats(){
  const months=last6Months();
  return months.map(m=>{
    const movs=S.movs.filter(mv=>getMonthKey(mv.ts)===m.key);
    const entries=movs.filter(mv=>mv.type==='in');
    const exits  =movs.filter(mv=>mv.type==='out');
    const spend  =entries.reduce((s,mv)=>{
      if(mv.valor&&mv.valor>0) return s+mv.valor;
      const it=getItem(mv.itemId);
      return s+(it&&it.preco?(it.preco*mv.qty):0);
    },0);
    return {
      key:m.key,label:m.label,
      inQty:entries.reduce((s,mv)=>s+mv.qty,0),
      outQty:exits.reduce((s,mv)=>s+mv.qty,0),
      inCount:entries.length, outCount:exits.length,
      spend
    };

function monthStats(){
  const months=last6Months();
  return months.map(m=>{
    const movs=S.movs.filter(mv=>getMonthKey(mv.ts)===m.key);
    const entries=movs.filter(mv=>mv.type==='in');
    const exits  =movs.filter(mv=>mv.type==='out');
    const spend  =entries.reduce((s,mv)=>{
      if(mv.valor&&mv.valor>0) return s+mv.valor;
      const it=getItem(mv.itemId);
      return s+(it&&it.preco?(it.preco*mv.qty):0);
    },0);
    return {
      key:m.key,label:m.label,
      inQty:entries.reduce((s,mv)=>s+mv.qty,0),
      outQty:exits.reduce((s,mv)=>s+mv.qty,0),
      inCount:entries.length, outCount:exits.length,
      spend
    };
  });
}

function openMovModal(type,itemId){
  document.getElementById('movTitle').textContent=type==='in'?'Registrar Entrada':'Registrar Saída';
  document.getElementById('movType').value=type;
  document.getElementById('movQty').value=1;
  document.getElementById('movResp').value=localStorage.getItem('stoq_resp')||'';
  document.getElementById('movObs').value='';
  document.getElementById('movValor').value='';
  const sel=document.getElementById('movProduct');
  sel.innerHTML=S.items.map(i=>
    `<option value="${i.id}" ${i.id===itemId?'selected':''}>${i.icon} ${i.name} (${i.qty} ${i.unit})</option>`
  ).join('');
  openModal('modalMov');
}
function quickMov(type){
  closeModal('modalDetail');
  setTimeout(()=>openMovModal(type,S.detailId),200);
}
function saveMov(){
  const itemId=document.getElementById('movProduct').value;
  const qty=parseInt(document.getElementById('movQty').value)||0;
  const type=document.getElementById('movType').value;
  const resp=document.getElementById('movResp').value.trim();
  const obs=document.getElementById('movObs').value.trim();
  const valor=parseFloat(document.getElementById('movValor').value)||0;
  if(!qty||qty<1){toast('Quantidade inválida','err');return}
  const idx=S.items.findIndex(i=>i.id===itemId);
  if(idx===-1)return;
  if(type==='out'&&S.items[idx].qty<qty){
    toast(`Estoque insuficiente — disponível: ${S.items[idx].qty} ${S.items[idx].unit}`,'err');
    return;
  }
  S.items[idx].qty+=type==='in'?qty:-qty;
  S.movs.push({id:uid(),itemId,type,qty,resp,obs,valor,ts:Date.now()});
  save();closeModal('modalMov');
  toast(type==='in'?`+${qty} unidades adicionadas`:`-${qty} unidades retiradas`,'ok');
  if(S.screen==='estoqu

// ── ESTOQUE tab ───────────────────────────
function _renderRelEstoque(){
  const total  = S.items.length;
  const ok     = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='ok').length;
  const warn   = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='warn').length;
  const danger = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='danger'||i.qty===0).length;
  const valorTotal = S.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco||0)*i.qty,0);

  document.getElementById('relStatCards').innerHTML = `
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--accent)">${total}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Total de Itens</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--green)">${ok}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">OK</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--yellow)">${warn}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Em Alerta</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--red)">${danger}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Críticos</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--blue)">${fmtR(valorTotal)}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Valor Total em Estoque</div></div>
  `;

  // Saúde doughnut
  mkChart('chartSaude',{
    type:'doughnut',
    data:{
      labels:['OK','Alerta','Crítico'],
      datasets:[{data:[ok,warn,danger],backgroundColor:['rgba(46,213,115,.8)','rgba(245,200,66,.8)','rgba(255,71,87,.8)'],borderWidth:0,hoverOffset:6}]
    },
    options:{...CH_DOUGHNUT, cutout:'70%'}
  });

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// CSV EXPORT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function exportCSV(){
  const tab = _relTab;
  let csv = '', filename = 'stoq-';
  if(tab==='estoque'){
    filename += 'estoque';
    csv = 'Item,Categoria,Ícone,Qtd,Unidade,Mínimo,Localização,Preço Unit.,Valor Total,Status\n';
    S.items.forEach(it=>{
      const st = itemStatus(it);
      csv += `"${it.name}","${CAT[it.cat]?.label||it.cat}","${it.icon}",${it.qty},"${it.unit}",${it.min},"${it.loc||''}",${it.preco||0},${(it.preco||0)*it.qty},"${st.label}"\n`;
    });
  } else if(tab==='movs'){
    filename += 'movimentacoes';
    csv = 'Data,Item,Tipo,Qtd,Unidade,Responsável,Observação,Valor\n';
    [...S.movs].sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts).forEach(m=>{
      const it = getItem(m.itemId);
      csv += `"${new Date(m.ts).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}","${it?.name||'?'}","${m.type==='in'?'Entrada':'Saída'}",${m.qty},"${it?.unit||''}","${m.resp||''}","${m.obs||''}",${m.valor||0}\n`;
    });
  } else {
    filename += 'financeiro';
    csv = 'Mês,Entradas Qtd,Saídas Qtd,Nº Compras,Gasto Estimado\n';
    monthStats().forEach(m=>{
      csv += `"${m.label}",${m.inQty},${m.outQty},${m.inCount},${m.spend.toFixed(2)}\n`;
    });
  }
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = filename + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv';
  a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  toast('CSV exportado','ok');
}

function renderBudgetBars(){
  const el = document.getElementById('budgetBars');
  if(!el) return;
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  const now = new Date();
  const mesKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;

  // Calculate spend per category this month
  const catSpend = {};
  S.movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in'&&getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesKey).forEach(m=>{
    const it = getItem(m.itemId); if(!it) return;
    const v = m.valor>0?m.valor:(it.preco||0)*m.qty;
    catSpend[it.cat] = (catSpend[it.cat]||0)+v;
  });

  const hasBudget = Object.entries(budgets).filter(([,v])=>v>0);
  if(!hasBudget.length){
    el.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px">Nenhum orçamento definido ainda.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = hasBudget.map(([key, budget])=>{
    const cat = CAT[key];
    const spent = catSpend[key]||0;
    const pct = budget>0 ? Math.min(spent/budget*100,100) : 0;
    const over = spent>budget;
    const color = over?'var(--red)':pct>80?'var(--yellow)':'var(--accent)';
    return `<div style="margin-bottom:14px">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px">
          <span style="font-size:14px">${cat.emoji}</span>
          <span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:500">${cat.label}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px">
          <span style="color:${color};font-weight:600">${fmtR(spent)}</span>
          <span style="color:var(--text3)"> / ${fmtR(budget)}</span>
          ${over?`<span style="color:var(--red);font-size:10px;margin-left:4px">+${fmtR(spent-budget)}</span>`:''}
    
---
eDashboardBudgetAlert();
}

function updateDashboardBudgetAlert(){
  // Warn in dashboard if any category is over budget
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  const now = new Date();
  const mesKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  const catSpend = {};
  S.movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in'&&getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesKey).forEach(m=>{
    const it=getItem(m.itemId); if(!it) return;
    const v=m.valor>0?m.valor:(it.preco||0)*m.qty;
    catSpend[it.cat]=(catSpend[it.cat]||0)+v;
  });
  const overBudget = Object.entries(budgets).filter(([k,v])=>v>0&&(catSpend[k]||0)>v);
  if(overBudget.length){
    const cats = overBudget.map(([k])=>CAT[k]?.emoji+' '+CAT[k]?.label).join(', ');
    // Show as a toast once per session
    if(!window._budgetAlerted){
      window._budgetAlerted = true;
      setTimeout(()=>toast(`💰 Orçamento excedido: ${cats}`,'err'),1500);
    }
  }
}

!it) return;

  if(type === 'out' && it.qty < 1){
    toast('Estoque zerado — sem itens para retirar','err'); return;
  }

  // Inline +1/-1 with qty bump overlay — no modal needed for quick ops
  const delta = type === 'in' ? 1 : -1;
  const idx   = S.items.findIndex(i=>i.id===id); if(idx===-1) return;
  S.items[idx].qty = Math.max(0, S.items[idx].qty + delta);

  });
  save(); updateBanners();

  // Show floating bump badge
  _showQtyBump(type, it.name, S.items[idx].qty, it.unit);

  // Re-render only the affected card in-place
  filterItems();
}

function swipeEdit(id){
  _closeRow(id, true);
  S.detailId = id;
  setTimeout(()=>editCurrentItem(), 80);
}

function _showQtyBump(type, name, newQty, unit){
  const old = document.querySelector('.qty-bump');
  if(old) old.remove();
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = `qty-bump ${type}`;
  el.innerHTML = `<span>${type==='in'?'▲':'▼'} ${name}</span><strong>${newQty} ${unit}</strong>`;
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(()=>{ el.style.opacity='0'; el.style.transition='opacity .3s'; }, 1600);
  setTimeout(()=>el.remove(), 1950);
}

    </div>
    ${sugs.map(s=>`
      <div class="sug-item">
        <div class="sug-icon" style="background:${s.color}">${s.icon}</div>
        <div class="sug-body">
          <h4>${s.title}</h4>
          <p>${s.body}</p>
          <span class="sug-tag">${s.tag}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('')}
  `;
}

function monthStats(){
  const months=last6Months();
  return months.map(m=>{
    const movs=S.movs.filter(mv=>getMonthKey(mv.ts)===m.key);
    const entries=movs.filter(mv=>mv.type==='in');
    const exits  =movs.filter(mv=>mv.type==='out');
    const spend  =entries.reduce((s,mv)=>{
      if(mv.valor&&mv.valor>0) return s+mv.valor;
      const it=getItem(mv.itemId);
      return s+(it&&it.preco?(it.preco*mv.qty):0);
    },0);
    return {
      key:m.key,label:m.label,
      inQty:entries.reduce((s,mv)=>s+mv.qty,0),
      outQty:exits.reduce((s,mv)=>s+mv.qty,0),
      inCount:entries.length, outCount:exits.length,
      spend
    };
  });
}

function selEmoji(el,e){
  S.selEmoji=e;
  document.querySelectorAll('.eopt').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
  el.classList.add('sel');
}
function openAddModal(){
  S.editId=null; S.selEmoji='📦';
  document.getElementById('modalAddTitle').textContent='Novo Produto';
  document.getElementById('btnDelete').style.display='none';
  ['fName','fQty','fMin','fLoc','fObs','fThresh','fPreco'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value='');
  S._pendingPhoto=undefined;
  _resetPhotoUI();
  document.getElementById('fCat').value='limpeza';
  document.getElementById('fUnit').value='un';
  buildEmojiPicker();
  openModal('modalAdd');
}
function editCurrentItem(){
  closeModal('modalDetail');
  const it=getItem(S.detailId);if(!it)return;
  S.editId=it.id; S.selEmoji=it.icon;
  document.getElementById('modalAddTitle').textContent='Editar Produto';
  document.getElementById('btnDelete').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('fName').value=it.name;
  document.getElementById('fCat').value=it.cat;
  document.getElementById('fUnit').value=it.unit;
  document.getElementById('fQty').value=it.qty;
  document.getElementById('fMin').value=it.min;
  document.getElementById('fLoc').value=it.loc||'';
  document.getElementById('fObs').value=it.obs||'';
  document.getElementById('fThresh').value=it.thresh||'';
  document.getElementById('fPreco').value=it.preco||'';
  S._pendingPhoto=undefined;
  _resetPhotoUI(S.photos[it.id]||null);
  buildEmojiPicker();
  openModal('modalAdd');
}

  if(qty<0 || min<0 || preco<0 || (thresh!=='' && (isNaN(parseInt(thresh)) || parseInt(thresh)<0))){
    toast('Quantidade, mínimo, alerta e preço não podem ser negativos','err'); return;
  }
  const obj={
    name,icon:S.selEmoji,
    cat:document.getElementById('fCat').value,
    unit:document.getElementById('fUnit').value,
    qty,min,
    thresh:thresh===''?null:parseInt(thresh)||null,
    preco,
    loc:document.getElementById('fLoc').value.trim(),
    obs:document.getElementById('fObs').value.trim(),
  };
  // save photo separately in S.photos keyed by item id
  const photoId = S.editId || ('new_'+Date.now());
  if(S._pendingPhoto !== undefined){
    if(S._pendingPhoto) S.photos[photoId]=S._pendingPhoto;
    else delete S.photos[photoId];
    S._pendingPhoto=undefined;
  }
  if(S.editId){
    const idx=S.items.findIndex(i=>i.id===S.editId);
    S.items[idx]={...S.items[idx],...obj};
    if(S.photos[photoId]!==undefined && photoId!==S.editId){
      S.photos[S.editId]=S.photos[photoId]; delete S.photos[photoId];
    }
    toast('Produto atualizado','ok');
  } else {
    const newId=uid();
    S.items.push({id:newId,...obj});
    if(S.photos[photoId]){ S.photos[newId]=S.photos[photoId]; delete S.photos[photoId]; }
    toast('Produto adicionado','ok');
  }
  save();closeModal('modalAdd');
  if(S.screen==='estoque')renderEstoque();
  updateBanners();renderDashboard();
}

function renderListaItens(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaItens');
  const vazio = document.getElementById('listaVazia');
  if(!S.currentList.length){
    el.innerHTML = '';
    vazio.style.display = '';
    return;
  }
  vazio.style.display = 'none';
  el.innerHTML = S.currentList.map((it,i)=>{
    const checked = it.checked ? 'on' : '';
    const cls     = it.checked ? 'checked' : '';
    const prioCol = it.priority==='high'?'high':it.priority==='low'?'low':'medium';
    const preco   = it.preco > 0 ? fmtR(it.preco * it.qty) : '—';
    return `<div class="lista-item ${cls}" id="litem-${i}">
      <div class="lista-check ${checked}" onclick="toggleListaItem(${i})">${it.checked?'✓':''}</div>
      <div class="lista-prio ${prioCol}"></div>
      <div class="lista-info">
        <div class="lista-name">${it.icon||'📦'} ${it.name}</div>
        <div class="lista-meta">${CAT[it.cat]?.label||it.cat} · ${it.unit}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="lista-qty-ctrl">
        <button class="qbtn-sm" onclick="listaQty(${i},-1)">−</button>
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;min-width:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--accent)">${it.qty}</div>
        <button class="qbtn-sm" onclick="listaQty(${i},+1)">+</button>
      </div>
      <div class="lista-right">
        <div class="lista-qty">${it.unit}</div>
        <div class="lista-preco">${preco}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="lista-del" onclick="removerListaItem(${i})">×</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function renderListaResumo(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaResumo');
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('listaTotal');
  const metaEl  = document.getElementById('listaResumoItens');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('listaCount');
  if(!S.currentList.length){ el.style.display='none'; countEl.textContent=''; return; }
  el.style.display='';
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  totalEl.textContent = fmtR(total);
  metaEl.textContent  = `${S.currentList.length} itens · ${checked} marcados`;
  countEl.textContent = `(${S.currentList.length})`;
}

// ── Toggle item check ─────────────────────
function toggleListaItem(i){
  S.currentList[i].checked = !S.currentList[i].checked;
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
}

// ── Adjust quantity ───────────────────────
function listaQty(i, delta){
  const it = S.currentList[i];
  it.qty = Math.max(1, (it.qty||1) + delta);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo();
}

---
rate from alerts ─────────────
function autoGerarLista(){
  const alerts = S.items.filter(it=>itemStatus(it).level!=='ok');
  if(!alerts.length){ toast('Nenhum item em alerta para gerar lista','info'); return; }
  let added = 0;
  alerts.forEach(it=>{
    if(S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===it.id)) return;
    const needed = Math.max(1, it.min - it.qty + Math.ceil(it.min * 0.3));
    S.currentList.push({
      itemId:it.id, name:it.name, icon:it.icon, cat:it.cat,
      unit:it.unit, qty:needed, preco:it.preco||0, checked:false,
      priority: it.qty===0||it.qty<=it.min ? 'high' : 'medium'
    });
    added++;
  });
  save();
  if(document.getElementById('screen-lista').classList.contains('active')){
    setListaTab('atual', document.getElementById('ltAtual'));
    renderLista();
  }
  toast(`⚡ ${added} item${added>1?'s adicionados':'adicionado'} à lista`,'ok');
}

    const statusBg = st.level==='danger'?'var(--red-dim)':st.level==='warn'?'var(--yellow-dim)':'var(--green-dim)';
    return `<div class="lista-search

function adicionarNaLista(itemId){
  const it = S.items.find(i=>i.id===itemId);
  if(!it) return;
  const existing = S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===itemId);
  if(existing){ existing.qty++; toast(`+1 ${it.name}`,'ok'); }
  else {
    const needed = Math.max(1, it.min - it.qty + 1);
    S.currentList.push({
      itemId:it.id, name:it.name, icon:it.icon, cat:it.cat,
      unit:it.unit, qty:needed, preco:it.preco||0, checked:false, priority:'medium'
    });
    toast(`✓ ${it.name} adicionado`,'ok');
  }
  document.getElementById('listaSearchInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('listaSearchResults').innerHTML = '';
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
  document.getElementById('listaVazia').style.display='none';
}

// ── Save list ─────────────────────────────
function salvarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const name = prompt('Nome da lista (ex: Compras Março 2025):', 'Lista ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'));
  if(!name) return;
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  S.shoppingLists.unshift({
    id: uid(), name, ts: Date.now(),
    items: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S.currentList)),
    total, notes:''
  });
  if(S.shoppingLists.length > 20) S.shoppingLists.splice(20);
  S.currentList = [];
  save(); renderLista();
  toast(`✓ Lista "${name}" salva`,'ok');
}

// ── Export list ───────────────────────────
function exportarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const lines = ['LISTA DE COMPRAS — Stoq','Gerada em: '+new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR'),'─'.repeat(40),''];
  S.currentList.forEach(it=>{
    const checked = it.checked ? '[✓]' : '[ ]';
    lines.push(`${checked} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}${it.preco>0?' (est. '+fmtR(it.preco*it.qty)+')':''}`);
  });
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  lines.push('','─'.repeat(40));
  lines.push('Total estimado: '+fmtR(total));
  const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'lista-compras-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.txt';
  a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  toast('Lista exportada','ok');
}

function _renderRelEstoque(){
  const total  = S.items.length;
  const ok     = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='ok').length;
  const warn   = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='warn').length;
  const danger = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='danger'||i.qty===0).length;
  const valorTotal = S.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco||0)*i.qty,0);

  document.getElementById('relStatCards').innerHTML = `
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--accent)">${total}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Total de Itens</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--green)">${ok}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">OK</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--yellow)">${warn}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Em Alerta</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--red)">${danger}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Críticos</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--blue)">${fmtR(valorTotal)}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Valor Total em Estoque</div></div>
  `;

  // Saúde doughnut
  mkChart('chartSaude',{
    type:'doughnut',
    data:{
      labels:['OK','Alerta','Crítico'],
      datasets:[{data:[ok,warn,danger],backgroundColor:['rgba(46,213,115,.8)','rgba(245,200,66,.8)','rgba(255,71,87,.8)'],borderWidth:0,hoverOffset:6}]
    },
    options:{...CH_DOUGHNUT, cutout:'70%'}
  });

  // Categorias bar
  const catData = Object.entries(CAT).map(([key,c])=>({
    label:c.emoji+' '+c.label,
    count:S.items.filter(i=>i.cat===k
---

function _renderRelMovs(){
  const ms = monthStats();

  mkChart('chartMovs',{

      ]
    },
    options:CH_OPTS()
  });

  // Top 10 items by total movement

  const top10 = Object.entries(itemMovs)
    .map(([id,qty])=>({item:getItem(id),qty}))

  mkChart('chartTopMovs',{

  const catValKeys = Object.keys(catVal).filter(k=>catVal[k]>0);
  mkChart('chartValorCat',{
    type:'bar',

      labels: catValKeys.map(k=>CAT[k]?.emoji+' '+CAT[k]?.label||k),

    },

  });

  // Sugestões
  _renderSugestoes();
}

// CSV EXPORT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function exportCSV(){
  const tab = _relTab;
  let csv = '', filename = 'stoq-';
  if(tab==='estoque'){
    filename += 'estoque';
    csv = 'Item,Categoria,Ícone,Qtd,Unidade,Mínimo,Localização,Preço Unit.,Valor Total,Status\n';
    S.items.forEach(it=>{
      const st = itemStatus(it);
      csv += `"${it.name}","${CAT[it.cat]?.label||it.cat}","${it.icon}",${it.qty},"${it.unit}",${it.min},"${it.loc||''}",${it.preco||0},${(it.preco||0)*it.qty},"${st.label}"\n`;
    });
  } else if(tab==='movs'){
    filename += 'movimentacoes';
    csv = 'Data,Item,Tipo,Qtd,Unidade,Responsável,Observação,Valor\n';
    [...S.movs].sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts).forEach(m=>{
      const it = getItem(m.itemId);
      csv += `"${new Date(m.ts).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}","${it?.name||'?'}","${m.type==='in'?'Entrada':'Saída'}",${m.qty},"${it?.unit||''}","${m.resp||''}","${m.obs||''}",${m.valor||0}\n`;
    });
  } else {
    filename += 'financeiro';
    csv = 'Mês,Entradas Qtd,Saídas Qtd,Nº Compras,Gasto Estimado\n';
    monthStats().forEach(m=>{
      csv += `"${m.label}",${m.inQty},${m.outQty},${m.inCount},${m.spend.toFixed(2)}\n`;
    });
  }
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = filename + '-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv';
  a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  toast('CSV exportado','ok');
}

function compartilharWhatsApp(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const data = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',y
---
t msg = `📋 *Lista de Compras — Stoq*\n📅 ${data}\n${'─'.repeat(30)}\n\n`;

  // Group by category
  const byCat = {};
  S.currentList.forEach(it=>{
    const catKey = it.cat||'outros';
    if(!byCat[catKey]) byCat[catKey]=[];
    byCat[catKey].push(it);
  });
  Object.entries(byCat).forEach(([cat,items])=>{
    const catInfo = CAT[cat]||{emoji:'📦',label:cat};
    msg += `*${catInfo.emoji} ${catInfo.label}*\n`;
    items.forEach(it=>{
      const chk = it.checked ? '✅' : '⬜';
      const est = it.preco>0 ? ` _(est. ${fmtR(it.preco*it.qty)})_` : '';
      msg += `${chk} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}${est}\n`;
    });
    msg += '\n';
  });

  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  msg += `${'─'.repeat(30)}\n`;
  msg += `📦 *${S.currentList.length} itens* · ✅ ${checked} marcados\n`;
  if(total>0) msg += `💰 *Total estimado: ${fmtR(total)}*\n`;
  msg += `\n_Gerado pelo Stoq_`;

  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(msg);
  const url = `https://wa.me/?text=${encoded}`;
  window.open(url, '_blank');
  toast('Abrindo WhatsApp…','ok');
}

function renderBudgetBars(){
  const el = document.getElementById('budgetBars');
  if(!el) return;
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  const now = new Date();
  const mesKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;

  // Calculate spend per category this month
  const catSpend = {};
  S.movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in'&&getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesKey).forEach(m=>{
    const it = getItem(m.itemId); if(!it) return;
    const v = m.valor>0?m.valor:(it.preco||0)*m.qty;
    catSpend[it.cat] = (catSpend[it.cat]||0)+v;
  });

  const hasBudget = Object.entries(budgets).filter(([,v])=>v>0);
  if(!hasBudget.length){
    el.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px">Nenhum orçamento definido ainda.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  el.innerHTML = hasBudget.map(([key, budget])=>{
    const cat = CAT[key];
    const spent = catSpend[key]||0;
    const pct = budget>0 ? Math.min(spent/budget*100,100) : 0;
    const over = spent>budget;
    const color = over?'var(--red)':pct>80?'var(--yellow)':'var(--accent)';
    return `<div style="margin-bottom:14px">
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px">
        <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px">
          <span style="font-size:14px">${cat.emoji}</span>
          <span style="font-size:13px;font-weight:500">${cat.label}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px">
          <span style="color:${color};font-weight:600">${fmtR(spent)}</span>
          <span style="color:var(--text3)"> / ${fmtR(budget)}</span>
          ${over?`<span style="color:var(--red);font-size:10px;margin-left:4px">+${fmtR(spent-budget)}</span>`:''}
        </div>
      </d
---
-mono)">${pct.toFixed(0)}% utilizado</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function updateDashboardBudgetAlert(){
  // Warn in dashboard if any category is over budget
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  const now = new Date();
  const mesKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  const catSpend = {};
  S.movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in'&&getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesKey).forEach(m=>{
    const it=getItem(m.itemId); if(!it) return;
    const v=m.valor>0?m.valor:(it.preco||0)*m.qty;
    catSpend[it.cat]=(catSpend[it.cat]||0)+v;
  });
  const overBudget = Object.entries(budgets).filter(([k,v])=>v>0&&(catSpend[k]||0)>v);
  if(overBudget.length){
    const cats = overBudget.map(([k])=>CAT[k]?.emoji+' '+CAT[k]?.label).join(', ');
    // Show as a toast once per session
    if(!window._budgetAlerted){
      window._budgetAlerted = true;
      setTimeout(()=>toast(`💰 Orçamento excedido: ${cats}`,'err'),1500);
    }
  }
}

function renderAlertas(){
  // threshold
  const tw = document.getElementById('threshWarn');
  if(tw){ tw.value = S.settings.threshWarn||150; updateThreshLabel('warn'); }
  const cf = document.getElementById('confFreq');
  if(cf){ cf.value = S.settings.confFreq||30; }

  // items threshold list
  const tl = document.getElementById('threshList');
  if(tl) tl.innerHTML = S.items.map(it=>`
    <div class="alert-thresh-row">
      <div class="atr-info">
        <div class="atr-name">${it.icon} ${it.name}</div>
        <div class="atr-cur">atual: ${it.qty} ${it.unit} · mín: ${it.min}</div>
      </div>
      <input type="number" class="atr-input" id="thresh_${it.id}"
        value="${it.thresh!=null?it.thresh:''}" placeholder="global" min="0"
        onchange="setThresh('${it.id}',this.value
---
es[m.itemId].firstTs=Math.min(rates[m.itemId].firstTs,m.ts);
  });
  let predicted=0;
  Object.entries(rates).forEach(([itemId,r])=>{
    const it=getItem(itemId); if(!it) return;
    const span=Math.max(1,(now-r.firstTs)/86400000);
    const taxa=r.qty/span;
    const dias=taxa>0?it.qty/taxa:999;
    if(dias<=15&&dias<999&&!S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===itemId)){
      S.currentList.push({
        itemId:it.id,name:it.name,icon:it.icon,cat:it.cat,
        unit:it.unit,qty:Math.ceil(taxa*30),preco:it.preco||0,checked:false,priority:'high'
      });
      predicted++;
    }
  });
  if(predicted>0){
    save();
    toast(`🔮 +${predicted} item${predicted>1?'s':''} por previsão de demanda`,'info');
    renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
    document.getElementById('listaVazia').style.display='none';
  }
}

const ACCENT_MAPS = {
  dark:{accent:'#00e5b8'}, midnight:{accent:'#a855f7'}, ocean:{accent:'#3b9eff'},
  ember:{accent:'#ff7040'}, forest:{accent:'#2ed573'}, rose:{accent:'#ff4757'},
  slate:{accent:'#7a9ab8'}, light:{accent:'#0066ff'}
};

function applyTheme(name, el){
  const t = THEMES[name]; if(!t) return;
  const root = document.documentElement;
  Object.entries(t).forEach(([k,v])=> root.style.setProperty('--'+k, v));
  // Apply matching accent if user hasn't customized
  if(ACCENT_MAPS[name] && !SP.get('customAccent',false)){
    applyAccentVar(ACCENT_MAPS[name].accent);
    syncAccentUI(ACCENT_MAPS[name].accent);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.theme-swatch').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('sel'));
  if(el) el.classList.add('sel');
  SP.set('theme', name);
  toast('Tema "' + name + '" aplicado','ok');
}

function applyAccent(hex, el){
  SP.set('customAccent', true);
  applyAccentVar(hex);
  syncAccentUI(hex);
  if(el){
    document.querySelectorAll('.accent-dot').forEach(d=>d.classList.remove('sel'));
    el.classList.add('sel');
  }
  SP.set('accent', hex);
}

function applyAccentVar(hex){
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const rgb = hexToRgbArr(hex);
  root.style.setProperty('--accent', hex);
  root.style.setProperty('--accent-dim', `rgba(${rgb},0.12)`);
  root.style.setProperty('--accent-glow', `rgba(${rgb},0.25)`);
}

function hexToRgbArr(hex){
  const r=parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16), g=parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16), b=parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
  return `${r},${g},${b}`;
}

  document.querySelectorAll('.accent-dot').forEach(d=>d.classList.remove('sel'));
  if(el) el.classList.add('sel');

function applyCustomAccent(){
  const v = document.getElementById('customAccentInput').value.trim();
  if(!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(v)){
    toast('Use o formato #RRGGBB (ex: #ff4500)','err'); return;
  }
  applyAccent(v, null);
  toast('Accent personalizado aplicado','ok');
}

function applyCustomAccent(){
  const v = document.getElementById('customAccentInput').value.trim();
  if(!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(v)){
    toast('Use o formato #RRGGBB (ex: #ff4500)','err'); return;
  }
  applyAccent(v, null);
  toast('Accent personalizado aplicado','ok');
}

    });

  // 5. High spend month

  if(maxSpendMonth.spend>0){
    insights.push({
      badge:'💰', color:'var(--purple-dim)', border:'rgba(168,85,247,.3)',
      title:`Maior gasto: ${maxSpendMonth.label}`,
      body:`Estimativa de ${fmtR(maxSpendMonth.spend)} em entradas. ${cur.spend>maxSpendMonth.spend*.8?'Este mês está encaminhando para ser um dos mais caros.':'Custo atual controlado.'}`,
      chips:''
    });
  }

  // 6. Completion score
  const withPrice=S.items.filter(i=>i.preco>0).length;
  const withLoc=S.items.filter(i=>i.loc&&i.loc.trim()).length;
  const score=Math.round(((withPrice+withLoc)/(S.items.length*2))*100);
  insights.push({
    badge:'⭐', color:'var(--accent-dim)', border:'rgba(0,229,184,.25)',
    title:`Qualidade dos dados: ${score}%`,
    body:`${withPrice} item${withPrice!==1?'s têm':'tem'} preço cadastrado; ${withLoc} tem${withLoc!==1?'':''} localização. Dados completos melhoram relatórios e análise de custo.`,
    chips:`<span class="insight-chip" style="background:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent)">${score}% completo</span>`
  });

  // Render
  el.innerHTML = insights.map(i=>`
    <div class="insight-card" style="background:${i.color};border-color:${i.border}">
      <div class="insight-card-head">
        <div class="insight-badge" style="background:${i.color}">${i.badge}</div>
        <div class="insight-title">${i.title}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="insight-sub">${i.body}</div>
      ${i.chips?`<div>${i.chips}</div>`:''}
    </div>`).join('');
}

function toggleFaq(qEl){
  const item=qEl.closest('.faq-item');
  const wasOpen=item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('open'));
  if(!wasOpen) item.classList.add('open');
}

function renderDashboard(){
  const d=new Date();
  document.getElementById('dashDate').textContent=
    d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{weekday:'long',day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});

  const now=new Date(); const mesKey=`${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  const movMes=S.movs.filter(m=>getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesKey).length;
  document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent=S.items.length;
  document.getElementById('statMovMes').textContent=movMes;
  document.getElementById('statBaixo').textContent=S.items.filter(it=>itemStatus(it).level==='warn').length;
  document.getElementById('statZerado').textContent=S.items.filter(it=>it.qty===0).length;

  const ms=monthStats();
  const cur=ms[ms.length-1],prev=ms[ms.length-2]||{spend:0,inQty:0,outQty:0};
  const spendTrend=prev.spend>0?((cur.spend-prev.spend)/prev.spend*100):0;
  document.getElementById('dashInsights').innerHTML=`
    <div class="icard i1"><div class="ic-label">Saídas Este Mês</div>
      <div class="ic-val">${cur.outQty}</div><div class="ic-sub">itens consumidos</div>
      <div class="ic-trend ${cur.outQty>prev.outQty?'trend-up':'trend-down'}">${cur.outQty>prev.outQty?'▲':'▼'} vs mês anterior</div>
    </div>
    <div class="icard i2"><div class="ic-label">Entradas Este Mês</div>
      <div class="ic-val">${cur.inQty}</div><div class="ic-sub">unidades recebidas</div>
      <div class="ic-trend ${cur.inQty>0?'trend-down':'trend-up'}">${cur.inCount} compras</div>
    </div>
    <div class="icard i3"><div class="ic-label">Gasto Estimado</div>
      <div class="ic-val" style="font-size:15px">${fmtR(cur.spend)}</div>
      <div class="ic-trend ${spendTrend>0?'trend-up':'tre

derAlertas();

// INSIGHTS

function renderInsights(){
  const ms=monthStats();
  const allSpends=ms.map(m=>m.spend);
  const maxSpend=Math.max(...allSpends,1);
  const maxMonth=ms.reduce((a,b)=>b.spend>a.spend?b:a,ms[0]);
  const minMonth=ms.filter(m=>m.spend>0).reduce((a,b)=>b.spend<a.spend?b:a,ms.filter(m=>m.spend>0)[0]);

  const consumo=S.items.map(it=>{
    const total=S.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId===it.id&&m.type==='out').reduce((s,m)=>s+m.qty,0);
    return{it,total};
  }).filter(x=>x.total>0).sort((a,b)=>b.total-a.total).slice(0,5);
  const maxCons=consumo.length>0?consumo[0].total:1;

  const rotacao=S.items.map(it=>{
    const mesAtual=ms[ms.length-1].key;
    const saidaMes=S.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId===it.id&&m.type==='out'&&getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesAtual).reduce((s,m)=>s+m.qty,0);
    const rot=it.qty>0?saidaMes/it.qty:0;
    return{it,saidaMes,rot};
  }).filter(x=>x.saidaMes>0).sort((a,b)=>b.rot-a.rot).slice(0,5);

  const forecasts=S.items.map(it=>{
    const last30=S.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId===it.id&&m.type==='out'&&m.ts>Date.now()-30*86400000).reduce((s,m)=>s+m.qty,0);
    const dailyRate=last30/30;
    const days=dailyRate>0?Math.floor(it.qty/dailyRate):Infinity;
    return{it,dailyRate,days};
  }).filter(x=>x.dailyRate>0).sort((a,b)=>a.days-b.days).slice(0,5);

  const colors=['var(--accent)','var(--blue)','var(--yellow)','var(--orange)','var(--purple)'];

  document.getElementById('insightsFull').innerHTML=`
    <div class="rcard" style="margin-bottom:12px">
      <h3>💰 Comparativo de Gastos — 6 Meses</h3>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px">
        <div style="flex:1;background:var(--red-dim);border:1px soli

function openMovModal(type,itemId){
  document.getElementById('movTitle').textContent=type==='in'?'Registrar Entrada':'Registrar Saída';
  document.getElementById('movType').value=type;
  document.getElementById('movQty').value=1;
  document.getElementById('movResp').value=localStorage.getItem('stoq_resp')||'';
  document.getElementById('movObs').value='';
  document.getElementById('movValor').value='';
  const sel=document.getElementById('movProduct');
  sel.innerHTML=S.items.map(i=>
    `<option value="${i.id}" ${i.id===itemId?'selected':''}>${i.icon} ${i.name} (${i.qty} ${i.unit})</option>`
  ).join('');
  openModal('modalMov');
}

function setConfFilter(f,btn){
  S.confFilter=f;
  document.querySelectorAll('#cfAll,#cfAlerts,#cfPending').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderConfList();
}
function renderConfList(){
  let items=[...S.items];
  if(S.confFilter==='alerts') items=items.filter(it=>itemStatus(it).level!=='ok');
  if(S.confFilter==='pending') items=items.filter(it=>!S.confChecked[it.id]);

  const checked=Object.values(S.confChecked).filter(Boolean).length;
  const total=S.items.length;
  document.getElementById('confProgress').textContent=`${checked}/${total}`;
  document.getElementById('confProgressBar').style.width=`${total>0?checked/total*100:0}%`;

  document.getElementById('confList').innerHTML=items.length===0
    ? `<div style="text-align:center;padding:20px;color:var(--green);font-size:13px">✓ Nenhum item nesta seleção</div>`
    : items.map(it=>{
        const st=itemStatus(it);
        const checked=S.confChecked[it.id];
        const isAlert=st.level!=='ok';
        return `<div class="conf-item">
          <div class="conf-check ${checked?'checked':''}" onclick="toggleConf('${it.id}')">${checked?'✓':''}</div>
          <div style="flex:1">
            <div class="conf-iname" style="color:${isAlert&&!checked?'var(--yellow)':'inherit'}">${it.icon} ${it.name}${isAlert?` <span style="font-size:10px;color:${st.level==='danger'?'var(--red)':'var(--yellow)'}">⚠ ${st.label}</span>`:''}</div>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono)">${CAT[it.cat].label} · ${it.loc||'sem local'}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="conf-qty ${isAlert?'alert':''}">${it.qty} ${it.unit}</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
}
function toggleConf(id){
  S.confChecked[id]=!S.confChecked[id];
  save();rende

function finalizarConferencia(){

  o.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===o)closeModal(o.id)});
});

function renderListaResumo(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaResumo');
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('listaTotal');
  const metaEl  = document.getElementById('listaResumoItens');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('listaCount');
  if(!S.currentList.length){ el.style.display='none'; countEl.textContent=''; return; }
  el.style.display='';
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  totalEl.textContent = fmtR(total);
  metaEl.textContent  = `${S.currentList.length} itens · ${checked} marcados`;
  countEl.textContent = `(${S.currentList.length})`;
}

// ── Toggle item check ─────────────────────
function toggleListaItem(i){
  S.currentList[i].checked = !S.currentList[i].checked;
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
}

// ── Adjust quantity ───────────────────────
function listaQty(i, delta){
  const it = S.currentList[i];
  it.qty = Math.max(1, (it.qty||1) + delta);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo();
}

}

// ── Save list ─────────────────────────────
function salvarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const name = prompt('Nome da lista (ex: Compras Março 2025):', 'Lista ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'));
  if(!name) return;
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  S.shoppingLists.unshift({
    id: uid(), name, ts: Date.now(),
    items: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S.currentList)),
    total, notes:''
  });
  if(S.shoppingLists.length > 20) S.shoppingLists.splice(20);
  S.currentList = [];
  save(); renderLista();
  toast(`✓ Lista "${name}" salva`,'ok');
}

// ── Export list ───────────────────────────
function exportarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const lines = ['LISTA DE COMPRAS — Stoq','Gerada em: '+new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR'),'─'.repeat(40),''];
  S.currentList.forEach(it=>{
    const checked = it.checked ? '[✓]' : '[ ]';
    lines.push(`${checked} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}${it.preco>0?' (est. '+fmtR(it.preco*it.qty)+')':''}`);
  });
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  lines.push('','─'.repeat(40));
  lines.push('Total estimado: '+fmtR(total));
  const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'lista-compras-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.txt';
  a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  toast('Lista exportada','ok');
}

    </div>`;

function atualizarComparacao(){
  const selA = document.getElementById('cmpA');
  const selB = document.getElementById('cmpB');
  if(!selA||!selB) return;
  const idxA = parseInt(selA.value);
  const idxB = parseInt(selB.value);
  if(idxA === idxB){ document.getElementById('cmpResult').innerHTML='<div style="color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;padding:8px">Selecione listas diferentes.</div>'; return; }
  const listA = S.shoppingLists[idxA];
  const listB = S.shoppingLists[idxB];
  const deltaTotal = listA.total - listB.total;
  const deltaPct   = listB.total > 0 ? ((listA.total-listB.total)/listB.total*100).toFixed(1) : 0;
  const deltaClass = deltaTotal > 0 ? 'up' : deltaTotal < 0 ? 'down' : 'same';

  // Union of all item names
  const allNames = [...new Set([...listA.items.map(i=>i.name),...listB.items.map(i=>i.name)])];

  const rows = allNames.map(name=>{
    const a = listA.items.find(i=>i.name===name);
    const b = listB.items.find(i=>i.name===name);
    const qA = a ? a.qty : 0;
    const qB = b ? b.qty : 0;
    const delta = qA - qB;
    const dcls = delta>0?'up':delta<0?'down':'same';
    const dTxt = delta>0?`+${delta}`:delta<0?`${delta}`:'=';
    return `<div class="cmp-row">
      <span style="font-size:12px">${(a||b)?.icon||'📦'} ${name}</span>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
        <span style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text2)">${qA||'—'} vs ${qB||'—'}</span>
        <span class="cmp-delta ${dcls}">${dTxt}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  document.getElementById('cmpResult').innerHTML = `
    <div class="compare-card">
      <div class="cmp-col">
        <div class="cmp-col-head">Lista A</div>
        <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px">${listA.name}</div>
---

function mkChart(id, config){
  const ctx = document.getElementById(id)?.getContext('2d');
  if(!ctx) return null;
  if(_charts[id]) _charts[id].destroy();
  _charts[id] = new Chart(ctx, config);
  return _charts[id];
}

// ── ESTOQUE tab ───────────────────────────
function _renderRelEstoque(){
  const total  = S.items.length;
  const ok     = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='ok').length;
  const warn   = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='warn').length;
  const danger = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='danger'||i.qty===0).length;
  const valorTotal = S.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco||0)*i.qty,0);

  document.getElementById('relStatCards').innerHTML = `
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--accent)">${total}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Total de Itens</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--green)">${ok}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">OK</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--yellow)">${warn}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Em Alerta</div></div>

  `;

  // Saúde doughnut
  mkChart('chartSaude',{

function _renderRelEstoque(){

  const ok     = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='ok').length;
  const warn   = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='warn').length;
  const danger = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='danger'||i.qty===0).length;
  const valorTotal = S.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco||0)*i.qty,0);

  document.getElementById('relStatCards').innerHTML = `
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--accent)">${total}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Total de Itens</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--green)">${ok}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">OK</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--yellow)">${warn}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Em Alerta</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--red)">${danger}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Críticos</div></div>
    <div class="rel-stat" style="grid-column:1/-1"><div class="rel-stat-val" style="color:var(--blue)">${fmtR(valorTotal)}</div><div class="rel-stat-lbl">Valor Total em Estoque</div></div>

    S.items.forEach(it=>{
      const st = itemStatus(it);
      csv += `"${it.name}","${CAT[it.cat]?.label||it.cat}","${it.icon}",${it.qty},"${it.unit}",${it.min},"${it.loc||''}",${it.preco||0},${(it.preco||0)*it.qty},"${st.label}"\n`;
    });
  } else if(tab==='movs'){
    filename += 'movimentacoes';

      const it = getItem(m.itemId);
      csv += `"${new Date(m.ts).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}","${it?.name||'?'}","${m.type==='in'?'Entrada':'Saíd

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// CSV EXPORT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function exportCSV(){
  const tab = _relTab;
  let csv = '', filename = 'stoq-';
  if(tab==='estoque'){
    filename += 'estoque';
    csv = 'Item,Categoria,Ícone,Qtd,Unidade,Mínimo,Localização,Preço Unit.,Valor Total,Status\n';
    S.items.forEach(it=>{
      const st = itemStatus(it);
      csv += `"${it.name}","${CAT[it.cat]?.label||it.cat}","${it.icon}",${it.qty},"${it.unit}",${it.min},"${it.loc||''}",${it.preco||0},${(it.preco||0)*it.qty},"${st.label}"\n`;
    });
  } else if(tab==='movs'){
    filename += 'movimentacoes';
    csv = 'Data,Item,Tipo,Qtd,Unidade,Responsável,Observação,Valor\n';
    [...S.movs].sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts).forEach(m=>{
      const it = getItem(m.itemId);
      csv += `"${new Date(m.ts).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}","${it?.name||'?'}","${m.type==='in'?'Entrada':'Saída'}",${m.qty},"${it?.unit||''}","${m.resp||''}","${m.obs||''}",${m.valor||0}\n`;
    });
  } else {
    filename += 'financeiro';
    csv = 'Mês,Entradas Qtd,Saídas Qtd,Nº Compras,Gasto Estimado\n';
    monthStats().forEach(m=>{
      csv += `"${m.label}",${m.inQty},${m.outQty},${m.inCount},${m.spend.toFixed(2)}\n`;
    });
  }
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF'+csv],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');

const SWIPE_W   = 204;  // total width of 3 action buttons (3 × 68px)

let _activeSwipe = null; // currently open row id

function initSwipeRows(){
  const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
  if(!isMobile) return;

  document.querySelectorAll('.swipe-row').forEach(row => {
    const id    = row.dataset.id;
    const card  = row.querySelector('.swipe-card');
    if(!card) return;

    let startX=0, startY=0, curX=0, dragging=false, wasOpen=false;

    card.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
      if(e.touches.length > 1) return;
      startX  = e.touches[0].clientX;
      startY  = e.touches[0].clientY;
      curX    = 0;
      dragging = false;
      wasOpen  = _activeSwipe === id;
      card.classList.add('no-transition');
    }, {passive:true});

    card.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
      const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - startX;
      const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;

      // decide direction once
      if(!dragging && Math.abs(dx) < 5 && Math.abs(dy) < 5) return;
      if(!dragging){
        if(Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) return; // vertical scroll — ignore
        dragging = true;
        // close any other open row
        if(_activeSwipe && _activeSwipe !== id) _closeRow(_activeSwipe, true);
      }

      e.preventDefault()

  function safeToast(msg,type='info'){
    try{ if(typeof toast==='function') toast(msg,type); }catch(e){}
  }

  function proFmtDays(days){
    if(!Number.isFinite(days)) return 'sem histórico';
    if(days <= 0) return 'hoje';
    if(days === 1) return '1 dia';
    return days + ' dias';
  }

  function proAverageOut(itemId,days=90){
    const from = Date.now() - days*86400000;
    const total = S.movs
      .filter(m=>m.itemId===itemId && m.type==='out' && m.ts>=from)
      .reduce((s,m)=>s+Number(m.qty||0),0);
    return total / days;
  }

  function proForecasts(){
    return S.items.map(it=>{
      const rate = proAverageOut(it.id,90);
      const days = rate>0 ? Math.floor(Number(it.qty||0)/rate) : Infinity;
      return {it,rate,days};
    }).filter(x=>x.rate>0).sort((a,b)=>a.days-b.days);
  }

  function proHealth(){
    const total = S.items.length || 1;
    const alerts = S.items.filter(it=>itemStatus(it).level!=='ok');
    const zerados = S.items.filter(it=>Number(it.qty||0)===0);
    const forecast = proForecasts();
    const risk7 = forecast.filter(x=>x.days<=7);
    const risk15 = forecast.filter(x=>x.days<=15);
    const lastConf = S.settings.lastConf || 0;
    const confDays = lastConf ? Math.floor((Date.now()-lastConf)/86400000) : Infinity;
    let score = 100;
    score -= Math.min(45, alerts.length * 8);
    score -= Math.min(25, zerados.length * 12);
    score -= Math.min(18, risk7.length * 6);
    if(confDays !== Infinity && confDays > Number(S.settings.confFreq||30)) score -= 8;
    if(confDays === Infinity) score -= 6;
    score = Math.max(0, Math.round(score));
    return {total,alerts,zerados,forecast,risk7,risk15,confDays,score};
  }

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// NAVIGATION
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
const SCREEN_TITLES = {
  dashboard:'Painel Geral', estoque:'Estoque', mov:'Movimentações',
  cats:'Categorias', alertas:'Alertas & Config.', insights:'Insights',
  lista:'Lista de Compras', relatorios:'Relatórios'
};

function showScreen(name){
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('screen-'+name).classList.add('active');

  document.querySelectorAll('.sidebar .nav-item').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));
  const sn=document.getElementById('nav-'+name);
  if(sn) sn.classList.add('active');

  document.querySelectorAll('.bottom-nav .nav-item').forEach(n=>n.classList.remove('active'));
  const mn=document.getElementById('nav-'+name+'-mob');
  if(mn) mn.classList.add('active');

  const ttl=document.getElementById('topbarTitle');
  if(ttl) ttl.textContent=SCREEN_TITLES[name]||name;

  S.screen=name;
  document.getElementById('mainScroll').scrollTop=0;
  closeMobileSidebar();

  updateListaBadge();
  const renders={
    dashboard:renderDashboard,estoque:renderEstoque,
    mov:renderMovs,cats:renderCats,
    alertas:renderAlertas,insights:renderInsightsAndPrevisao,
    lista:renderLista,relatorios:renderRelatorios
  };
  if(renders[name]) renders[name]();
}

    if(days>=freq){
      document.getElementById('confBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
      const cd=document.getElementById('confDot');
      if(cd) cd.style.display='block';
    }
  }

  const b=document.getElementById('badgeEstoque');
  if(b){ b.style.display=crit.length?'flex':'none'; b.textContent=crit.length>9?'9+':crit.length; }
}

function renderCats(){
  document.getElementById('catGrid').innerHTML=Object.entries(CAT).map(([k,v])=>{
    const cnt=S.items.filter(i=>i.cat===k).length;
    return `<div class="ccard" onclick="setCatFilter('${k}');showScreen('estoque')">
      <div class="cemoji">${v.emoji}</div>
      <div class="cname">${v.label}</div>
      <div class="ccount">${cnt} ${cnt===1?'item':'itens'}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

  try { S.shoppingLists = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_lists') || '[]'); } catch(e){}
  try { S.currentList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_clist') || '[]'); } catch(e){}
  try { S.photos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_photos') || '{}'); } catch(e){ S.photos={}; }
  if (localStorage.getItem('ec2_items') === null) seedData();
}

  S.selEmoji=e;
  document.querySelectorAll('.eopt').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
  el.classList.add('sel');
}
function openAddModal(){
  S.editId=null; S.selEmoji='📦';
  document.getElementById('modalAddTitle').textContent='Novo Produto';
  document.getElementById('btnDelete').style.display='none';
  ['fName','fQty','fMin','fLoc','fObs','fThresh','fPreco'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value='');
  S._pendingPhoto=undefined;
  _resetPhotoUI();
  document.getElementById('fCat').value='limpeza';
  document.getElementById('fUnit').value='un';
  buildEmojiPicker();
  openModal('modalAdd');
}

  openModal('modalAdd');
}

      S.photos[S.editId]=S.photos[photoId]; delete S.photos[photoId];
    }
    toast('Produto atualizado','ok');
  } else {
    const newId=uid();
    S.items.push({id:newId,...obj});
    if(S.photos[photoId]){ S.photos[newId]=S.photos[photoId]; delete S.photos[photoId]; }
    toast('Produto adicionado','ok');
  }
  save();closeModal('modalAdd');
  if(S.screen==='estoque')renderEstoque();
  updateBanners();renderDashboard();
}

function openMovModal(type,itemId){
  document.getElementById('movTitle').textContent=type==='in'?'Registrar Entrada':'Registrar Saída';
  document.getElementById('movType').value=type;
  document.getElementById('movQty').value=1;
  document.getElementById('movResp').value=localStorage.getItem('stoq_resp')||'';
  document.getElementById('movObs').value='';
  document.getElementById('movValor').value='';
  const sel=document.getElementById('movProduct');
  sel.innerHTML=S.items.map(i=>
    `<option value="${i.id}" ${i.id===itemId?'selected':''}>${i.icon} ${i.name} (${i.qty} ${i.unit})</option>`
  ).join('');
  openModal('modalMov');
}
function quickMov(type){
  closeModal('modalDetail');
  setTimeout(()=>openMovModal(type,S.detailId),200);
}

async function syncSBSave(){
  const url=document.getElementById('sbUrl').value.trim().replace(/\/$/,'');
  const key=document.getElementById('sbKey').value.trim();
  if(!url||!key){toast('URL e Key necessários','err');return;}
  sbLog('Enviando para Supabase…');
  const cloudSettings={...S.settings,__stoqBackupExtras:{confChecked:S.confChecked,shoppingLists:S.shoppingLists,currentList:S.currentList,photos:S.photos||{}}};
  const payload={id:'stoq-main',items:JSON.stringify(S.items),movs:JSON.stringify(S.movs),settings:JSON.stringify(cloudSettings),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};
  try{
    const res=await fetch(url+'/rest/v1/stoq_backups',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':key,'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Prefer':'resolution=merge-duplicates'},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if(res.ok||res.status===201||res.status===200){
      sbSetStatus('ok'); SP.set('sbUrl',url); SP.set('sbKey',key);
      sbLog('✓ Dados enviados para Supabase!');
      toast('✓ Salvo no Supabase','ok');
    } else {
      const err=await res.text();
      sbLog('Erro '+res.status+': '+err.slice(0,60));
    }
  } catch(e){ sbLog('Erro: '+e.message); toast('Falha no Supabase','err'); }
}

function confirmReset(){
  if(confirm('⚠️ Tem certeza? Todos os dados serão apagados permanentemente.')){
    // Keep an explicit empty inventory marker so demo seed does not resurrect after an intentional reset.
    localStorage.setItem('ec2_items','[]');
    localStorage.setItem('ec2_movs','[]');
    ['ec2_set','ec2_conf','ec2_lists','ec2_clist','ec2_photos'].forEach(k=>localStorage.removeItem(k));
    location.reload();
  }
}

function generateInsights(){
  const el=document.getElementById('insightsPaneContent');
  if(!el) return;
  if(!S.items.length){
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="insight-loading" style="padding:40px">
      <div style="font-size:32px;margin-bottom:12px">📦</div>
      <p>Adicione itens ao estoque para ver insights.</p>
    </div>`;
    return;
  }

  const insights=[];
  const now=Date.now();

  // 1. Critical items
  const critical=S.items.filter(i=>i.qty===0);
  const low=S.items.filter(i=>i.qty>0&&itemStatus(i).level!=='ok');
  if(critical.length){
    insights.push({
      badge:'🔴', color:'var(--red-dim)', border:'rgba(255,71,87,.3)',
      title:`${critical.length} item${critical.length>1?'s estão':'está'} zerado${critical.length>1?'s':''}`,
      body:`<strong>${critical.map(i=>i.icon+' '+i.name).join(', ')}</strong> precisam de reposição urgente.`,
      chips:critical.slice(0,3).map(i=>`<span class="insight-chip" style="background:var(--red-dim);color:var(--red)">${i.icon} ${i.name}</span>`).join('')
    });
  }
  if(low.length){
    insights.push({
      badge:'🟡', color:'var(--yellow-di
---
Scale(1); showZoom(1); }
      lastTap = now;
    }
  }, {passive:true});
})();

  if(!localStorage.getItem('sbHandleSeen')){
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const h = document.getElementById('sbHandle');
      if(h){ h.classList.add('pulse'); localStorage.setItem('sbHandleSeen','1'); }
    }, 2800);
  }
})();


// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// FOTO POR ITEM
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function handlePhotoUpload(e){
  const file = e.target.files[0]; if(!file) return;
  if(file.size > 3*1024*1024){ toast('Foto muito grande (máx 3MB)','err'); return; }
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = ev => {
    S._pendingPhoto = ev.target.result;
    _resetPhotoUI(ev.target.result);
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function _resetPhotoUI(src){
  const wrap   = document.getElementById('photoWrap');
  const rmBtn  = document.getElementById('fPhotoRemove');
  if(!wrap) return;
  // clear old img
  const oldImg = wrap.querySelector('img.ph-preview');
  if(oldImg) oldImg.remove();
  if(src){
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'ph-preview';
    img.src = src;
    img.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--rs)';
    wrap.appendChild(img);
    if(rmBtn) rmBtn.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    if(rmBtn) rmBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function removePhoto(){
  S._pendingPhoto = null;
  _resetPhotoUI(null);
  const fi = document.getElementById('fPhoto');
  if(fi) fi.value = '';
}

// RESPONSÁVEL FIXO

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// FOTO POR ITEM
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function handlePhotoUpload(e){
  const file = e.target.files[0]; if(!file) return;
  if(file.size > 3*1024*1024){ toast('Foto muito grande (máx 3MB)','err'); return; }
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = ev => {
    S._pendingPhoto = ev.target.result;
    _resetPhotoUI(ev.target.result);
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function _resetPhotoUI(src){
  const wrap   = document.getElementById('photoWrap');
  const rmBtn  = document.getElementById('fPhotoRemove');
  if(!wrap) return;
  // clear old img
  const oldImg = wrap.querySelector('img.ph-preview');
  if(oldImg) oldImg.remove();
  if(src){
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'ph-preview';
    img.src = src;
    img.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--rs)';
    wrap.appendChild(img);
    if(rmBtn) rmBtn.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    if(rmBtn) rmBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function removePhoto(){
  S._pendingPhoto = null;
  _resetPhotoUI(null);
  const fi = document.getElementById('fPhoto');
  if(fi) fi.value = '';
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// RESPONSÁVEL FIXO
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function salvarResponsavel(){
  const v = (document.getElementById('respNomeInput')?.value||'').trim();
  if(!v){ toast('Informe seu nome','err'); return; }
  localStorage.setItem('stoq_resp', v);
  _updateRespBadge();
  toast(`✓ Responsável salvo: ${v}`, 'ok');
  closeSettings();
}

  if(!v){ toast('Informe seu nome','err'); return; }

function _updateRespBadge(){
  const name = localStorage.getItem('stoq_resp')||'';
  const badge = document.getElementById('respBadge');
  if(badge){ badge.textContent = name ? name.split(' ')[0] : ''; badge.style.display = name ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; }
  // Restore in settings input if open
  const inp = document.getElementById('respNomeInput');
  if(inp && name) inp.value = name;
}

(function(){
  if(!localStorage.getItem('sbHandleSeen')){
    setTimeout(()=>{
      const h = document.getElementById('sbHandle');
      if(h){ h.classList.add('pulse'); localStorage.setItem('sbHandleSeen','1'); }
    }, 2800);
  }
})();


// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// FOTO POR ITEM
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function handlePhotoUpload(e){
  const file = e.target.files[0]; if(!file) return;
  if(file.size > 3*1024*1024){ toast('Foto muito grande (máx 3MB)','err'); return; }
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = ev => {
    S._pendingPhoto = ev.target.result;
    _resetPhotoUI(ev.target.result);
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function _resetPhotoUI(src){
  const wrap   = document.getElementById('photoWrap');
  const rmBtn  = document.getElementById('fPhotoRemove');
  if(!wrap) return;
  // clear old img
  const oldImg = wrap.querySelector('img.ph-preview');
  if(oldImg) oldImg.remove();
  if(src){
    const img = document.createElement('img');
    img.className = 'ph-preview';
    img.src = src;
    img.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:var(--rs)';
    wrap.appendChild(img);
    if(rmBtn) rmBtn.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    if(rmBtn) rmBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function removePhoto(){
  S._pendingPhoto = null;
  _resetPhotoUI(null);
  const fi = document.getElementById('fPhoto');
  if(fi) fi.value = '';
}

// MOVIMENTAÇÕES
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function renderMovs(){
  let movs=[...S.movs].sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts);
  if(S.movFilter==='in')  movs=movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in');
  if(S.movFilter==='out') movs=movs.filter(m=>m.type==='out');
  const list=document.getElementById('movList');
  if(!movs.length){
    list.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><div class="big">🔄</div><p>Nenhuma movimentação.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML=movs.map(m=>{
    const it=getItem(m.itemId);if(!it)return'';
    return `<div class="mitem">
      <div class="marrow ${m.type}">${m.type==='in'?'▲':'▼'}</div>
      <div class="minfo">
        <div class="mname">${it.icon} ${it.name}</div>
        <div class="mmeta">${m.resp||'—'} · ${fmtDate(m.ts)}${m.obs?' · '+m.obs:''}${m.valor>0?' · '+fmtR(m.valor):''}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mqty ${m.type}">${m.type==='in'?'+':'-'}${m.qty} ${it.unit}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function setMovFilter(f,btn){
  S.movFilter=f;
  document.querySelectorAll('#mtAll,#mtIn,#mtOut').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderMovs();
}

function renderListaResumo(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaResumo');
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('listaTotal');
  const metaEl  = document.getElementById('listaResumoItens');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('listaCount');
  if(!S.currentList.length){ el.style.display='none'; countEl.textContent=''; return; }
  el.style.display='';
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  totalEl.textContent = fmtR(total);
  metaEl.textContent  = `${S.currentList.length} itens · ${checked} marcados`;
  countEl.textContent = `(${S.currentList.length})`;
}

// ── Toggle item check ─────────────────────
function toggleListaItem(i){
  S.currentList[i].checked = !S.currentList[i].checked;
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
}

// ── Adjust quantity ───────────────────────
function listaQty(i, delta){
  const it = S.currentList[i];
  it.qty = Math.max(1, (it.qty||1) + delta);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo();
}

function previewBudget(key){
  const val = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`budget_${key}`)?.value)||0;
  if(!S.settings.budgets) S.settings.budgets={};
  S.settings.budgets[key] = val;
  renderBudgetBars();
}

function renderBudgetBars(){
  const el = document.getElementById('budgetBars');
  if(!el) return;
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  const now = new Date();
  const mesKey = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}`;

  // Calculate spend per category this month
  const catSpend = {};
  S.movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in'&&getMonthKey(m.ts)===mesKey).forEach(m=>{
    const it = getItem(m.itemId); if(!it) return;
    const v = m.valor>0?m.valor:(it.preco||0)*m.qty;
    catSpend[it.cat] = (catSpend[it.cat]||0)+v;
  });

  const hasBudget = Object.entries(budgets).filter(([,v])=>v>0);
  if(!hasBudget.length){
    el.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:12px">Nenhum orçamento definido ainda.</div>`;
    return;
  }

function buildOperationalSnapshot() {
  return {
    app:'Stoq', version:4,
    items:S.items, movs:S.movs, settings:S.settings,
    confChecked:S.confChecked,
    shoppingLists:S.shoppingLists,

function validateOperationalSnapshot(d) {
  return !!(d && typeof d==='object' && !Array.isArray(d) &&
    Array.isArray(d.items) && Array.isArray(d.movs) &&
    d.settings && typeof d.settings==='object' && !Array.isArray(d.settings));
}
function applyOperationalSnapshot(d) {
  if(!validateOperationalSnapshot(d)) throw new Error('Estrutura de backup inválida');
  S.items=d.items;
  S.movs=d.movs;
  S.settings={...S.settings,...d.settings};
  if(Array.isArray(d.shoppingLists)) S.shoppingLists=d.shoppingLists;
  if(Array.isArray(d.currentList)) S.currentList=d.currentList;
  if(d.photos && typeof d.photos==='object' && !Array.isArray(d.photos)) S.photos=d.photos;
  if(d.confChecked && typeof d.confChecked==='object' && !Array.isArray(d.confChecked)) S.confChecked=d.confChecked;
  save();
}

function saveMov(){
  const itemId=document.getElementById('movProduct').value;
  const qty=parseInt(document.getElementById('movQty').value)||0;
  const type=document.getElementById('movType').value;
  const resp=document.getElementById('movResp').value.trim();
  const obs=document.getElementById('movObs').value.trim();
  const valor=parseFloat(document.getElementById('movValor').value)||0;
  if(!qty||qty<1){toast('Quantidade inválida','err');return}
  const idx=S.items.findIndex(i=>i.id===itemId);
  if(idx===-1)return;
  if(type==='out'&&S.items[idx].qty<qty){
    toast(`Estoque insuficiente — disponível: ${S.items[idx].qty} ${S.items[idx].unit}`,'err');
    return;
  }
  S.items[idx].qty+=type==='in'?qty:-qty;
  S.movs.push({id:uid(),itemId,type,qty,resp,obs,valor,ts:Date.now()});
  save();closeModal('modalMov');
  toast(type==='in'?`+${qty} unidades adicionadas`:`-${qty} unidades retiradas`,'ok');
  if(S.screen==='estoque')renderEstoque();
  if(S.screen==='mov')renderMovs();
  updateBanners();
  if(S.screen==='dashboard')renderDashboard();
}

// PWA — Service Worker + Install Prompt
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
let deferredInstallPrompt = null;

// Registro do Service Worker centralizado no módulo PRO final.
// Mantemos aqui apenas o prompt de instalação para evitar registro duplicado.

window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  deferredInstallPrompt = e;
  setTimeout(showInstallBanner, 3000);
});

function showInstallBanner(){
  if(!deferredInstallPrompt) return;
  const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');
  if(banner) banner.classList.remove('hidden');
}

function installApp(){
  if(!deferredInstallPrompt) return;
  deferredInstallPrompt.prompt();
  deferredInstallPrompt.userChoice.then(choice=>{
    deferredInstallPrompt = null;
    const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');
    if(banner) banner.classList.add('hidden');
    if(choice.outcome==='accepted') toast('✓ App instalado com sucesso!','ok');
  });
}

function closeInstallBanner(){
  const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');
  if(banner) banner.classList.add('hidden');
}

window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
  deferredInstallPrompt = null;
  toast('✓ Stoq instalado!','ok');
});

function toast(msg,type='ok'){
  const c=document.getElementById('toastWrap');
  const t=document.createElement('div');
  t.className=`toast ${type}`;
  const icons={ok:'✓',err:'✕',info:'ℹ'};

let _recog = null, _vozActive = false;
const NUM_WORDS = {'um':1,'uma':1,'dois':2,'duas':2,'três':3,'tres':3,'quatro':4,'cinco':5,'seis':6,'sete':7,'oito':8,'nove':9,'dez':10,'doze':12,'quinze':15,'vinte':20,'trinta':30,'quarenta':40,'cinquenta':50};

function iniciarVoz(){
  const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  if(!SR){ toast('Reconhecimento de voz não suportado neste navegador','err'); return; }
  if(_vozActive){ pararVoz(); return; }
  _recog = new SR();
  _recog.lang = 'pt-BR';
  _recog.continuous = true;
  _recog.interimResults = true;
  _vozActive = true;
  document.getElementById('vozBanner').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('btnVoz').style.background = 'rgba(59,158,255,.15)';
  document.getElementById('btnVoz').style.borderColor = 'rgba(59,158,255,.5)';
  _recog.onresult = e => {
    const last = e.results[e.results.length-1];
    const txt  = last[0].transcript.trim();
    document.getElementById('vozText').innerHTML = `<strong>Ouvindo…</strong> "${txt}"`;
    if(last.isFinal) processarVoz(txt);
  };
  _recog.onerror = e => { toast('Erro de voz: '+e.error,'err'); pararVoz(); };
  _recog.onend   = () => { if(_vozActive) _recog.start(); };
  _recog.start();
  toast('🎤 Ouvindo — diga item e quantidade (ex: "5 detergentes")','info');
}

function pararVoz(){
  _vozActive = false;
  if(_recog){ _recog.stop(); _recog = null; }
  document.getElementById('vozBanner').classList.add('hidden');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnVoz');
  if(btn){ btn.style.background=''; btn.style.borderColor=''; }

function vozAjustarQty(delta, itemId){
  const el = document.getElementById('vozQty');
  if(!el) return;
  const cur = parseInt(el.textContent)||1;
  el.textContent = Math.max(1, cur+delta);
}

function confirmarVoz(itemId){
  const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('vozQty')?.textContent)||1;
  adicionarNaLista(itemId);
  // fix qty
  const l = S.currentList.find(i=>i.itemId===itemId);
  if(l){ l.qty = qty; save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); }
  document.getElementById('vozConfirmArea')?.remove();
  toast(`✓ Adicionado por voz (${qty} un)`, 'ok');
}

function cancelarVoz(){
  document.getElementById('vozConfirmArea')?.remove();
}

  el.innerHTML = Object.entries(CAT).map(([key,cat])=>`
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">

      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono)">R$</span>

  renderBudgetBars();
}

---

let _systemMQ  = null;

function setThemeMode(mode) {
  _themeMode = mode;
  localStorage.setItem('themeMode', mode);

  // Clear listeners
  if(_systemMQ)  { try{ _systemMQ.removeEventListener('change', _onSystemChange); }catch(e){} _systemMQ=null; }
  if(_autoTimer) { clearInterval(_autoTimer); _autoTimer=null; }

  if(mode === 'dark')   { applyColorScheme('dark'); }
  else if(mode === 'light') { applyColorScheme('light'); }
  else if(mode === 'system') {
    _systemMQ = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
    applyColorScheme(_systemMQ.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
    _systemMQ.addEventListener('change', _onSystemChange);
  }
  else if(mode === 'auto') {
    _applyAutoTheme();
    _autoTimer = setInterval(_applyAutoTheme, 60000);
  }

  // Update UI
  const ti = document.getElementById('themeIcon');
  const td = document.getElementById('themeIndicator');
  const info = THEME_ICONS[mode];
  if(ti) ti.innerHTML = info.svg;
  if(td) td.style.background = info.dot;

  document.querySelectorAll('.tp-item').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('active'));
  const active = document.getElementById('tp-'+mode);
  if(active) active.classList.add('active');

  closethemePop();
}

function _onSystemChange(e) { applyColorScheme(e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light'); }

function _applyAutoTheme() {
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  applyColorScheme(h >= 19 || h < 7 ? 'dark' : 'light');
}

function applyColorScheme(scheme) {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', scheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  if(scheme === 'dark')  document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
}

  function proFmtDays(days){
    if(!Number.isFinite(days)) return 'sem histórico';
    if(days <= 0) return 'hoje';
    if(days === 1) return '1 dia';
    return days + ' dias';
  }

  function proAverageOut(itemId,days=90){
    const from = Date.now() - days*86400000;
    const total = S.movs
      .filter(m=>m.itemId===itemId && m.type==='out' && m.ts>=from)
      .reduce((s,m)=>s+Number(m.qty||0),0);
    return total / days;
  }

  function proForecasts(){
    return S.items.map(it=>{
      const rate = proAverageOut(it.id,90);
      const days = rate>0 ? Math.floor(Number(it.qty||0)/rate) : Infinity;
      return {it,rate,days};
    }).filter(x=>x.rate>0).sort((a,b)=>a.days-b.days);

  e.preventDefault();

  setTimeout(showInstallBanner, 3000);

  const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');
  if(banner) banner.classList.remove('hidden');
}
