// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// PWA — Service Worker + Install Prompt
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
let deferredInstallPrompt = null;

// Registro do Service Worker centralizado no módulo PRO final.
// Mantemos aqui apenas o prompt de instalação para evitar registro duplicado.

window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  deferredInstallPrompt = e;
  setTimeout(showInstallBanner, 3000);
});

function showInstallBanner(){
  if(!deferredInstallPrompt) return;
  const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');
  if(banner) banner.classList.remove('hidden');
}

function installApp(){
  if(!deferredInstallPrompt) return;
  deferredInstallPrompt.prompt();
  deferredInstallPrompt.userChoice.then(choice=>{
    deferredInstallPrompt = null;
    const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');
    if(banner) banner.classList.add('hidden');
    if(choice.outcome==='accepted') toast('✓ App instalado com sucesso!','ok');
  });
}

function closeInstallBanner(){
  const banner = document.getElementById('installBanner');

  const t=document.createElement('div');

  const icons={ok:'✓',err:'✕',info:'ℹ'};

  setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),3100);
}

// ── Tab switching ─────────────────────────
function switchSpTab(name, btn){
  document.querySelectorAll('.sp-tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.sp-tab-pane').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('spPane-'+name).classList.add('active');
  if(name==='insights') generateInsights();
  if(name==='sobre') updateAboutStats();
}

// ── Persist settings in localStorage ──────
const SP = (function(){
  let d = {};
  try { d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('spSettings')||'{}'); } catch{}
  return {
    get:(k,def)=> k in d ? d[k] : def,
    set:(k,v)=>{ d[k]=v; localStorage.setItem('spSettings',JSON.stringify(d)); }
  };
})();

function _onSystemChange(e) { applyColorScheme(e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light'); }

function _applyAutoTheme() {
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  applyColorScheme(h >= 19 || h < 7 ? 'dark' : 'light');
}

function applyColorScheme(scheme) {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', scheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  if(scheme === 'dark')  document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
}

(function initPinchZoom() {
  const scrollEl = document.getElementById('mainScroll');
  if(!scrollEl) return;

  // Wrap all screen children in a zoom layer
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.id = 'zoomWrap';
  wrap.style.cssText = 'transform-origin:top center;transition:transform .08s linear;will-change:transform;';
  while(scrollEl.firstChild) wrap.appendChild(scrollEl.firstChild);
  scrollEl.appendChild(wrap);

  const indicator = document.getElementById('zoomIndicator'
---
ator.classList.add('visible');
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    hideTimer = setTimeout(()=>indicator.classList.remove('visible'), 1200);
  }

  function applyScale(s) {
    scale = Math.max(1, Math.min(4, s));
    wrap.style.transform = scale === 1 ? '' : `scale(${scale})`;
    // When zoomed, allow horizontal scroll for wide content
    scrollEl.style.overflowX = scale > 1 ? 'auto' : 'hidden';
    if(scale === 1) indicator?.classList.remove('visible');
    else showZoom(scale);
  }

  scrollEl.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    if(e.touches.length === 2) {
      startDist  = dist(e.touches);
      startScale = scale;
      e.stopPropagation();
    }
  }, {passive:true});

  scrollEl.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
    if(e.touches.length !== 2) return;
    const d = dist(e.touches);
    applyScale(startScale * (d / startDist));
  }, {passive:true});

  // Double-tap to reset
  let lastTap = 0;
  scrollEl.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
    if(e.touches.length === 0 && e.changedTouches.length === 1) {
      const now = Date.now();
      if(now - lastTap < 280) { applyScale(1); showZoom(1); }
      lastTap = now;
    }
  }, {passive:true});
})();

function initSwipeRows(){
  const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
  if(!isMobile) return;

  document.querySelectorAll('.swipe-row').forEach(row => {
    const id    = row.dataset.id;
    const card  = row.querySelector('.swipe-card');
    if(!card) return;

    let startX=0, startY=0, curX=0, dragging=false, wasOpen=false;

    card.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
      if(e.touches.length > 1) return;
      startX  = e.touches[0].clientX;
      startY  = e.touches[0].clientY;
      curX    = 0;
      dragging = false;
      wasOpen  = _activeSwipe === id;
      card.classList.add('no-transition');
    }, {passive:true});

    card.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
      const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - startX;
      const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - startY;

      // decide direction once
      if(!dragging && Math.abs(dx) < 5 && Math.abs(dy) < 5) return;
      if(!dragging){
        if(Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) return; // vertical scroll — ignore
        dragging = true;
        // close any other open row
        if(_activeSwipe && _activeSwipe !== id) _closeRow(_activeSwipe, true);
      }

      e.preventDefault(); // block scroll while swiping

      const base  = wasOpen ? -SWIPE_W : 0;
      let   target = base + dx;

      // rubber band beyond limits
      if(target > 12){
        target = 12 + (target - 12) * 0.18;
      } else if(target < -SWIPE_W - 30){
        const over = target + SWIPE_W;
        target = -SWIPE_W + over * 0.18;
      }

      curX = target;
      card.style.transform = `translateX(${target}px)`;
    }, {passive:false});

    card.addEventListener('touchend', ()

function _openRow(id){
  const card = document.getElementById('sc-'+id);
  if(!card) return;
  card.classList.remove('no-transition');
  card.style.cssText += '; --sw-offset:-'+SWIPE_W+'px';
  card.style.transform = `translateX(-${SWIPE_W}px)`;
  _activeSwipe = id;
}

      } else {
        _closeRow(id, false);
      }
      dragging = false;
    }, {passive:true});
  });

  // Tap anywhere outside to close
  document.getElementById('mainScroll')?.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
    if(_activeSwipe && !e.target.closest(`#sr-${_activeSwipe}`)){
      _closeRow(_activeSwipe, true);
    }
  }, {passive:true});
}

function _openRow(id){
  const card = document.getElementById('sc-'+id);
  if(!card) return;
  card.classList.remove('no-transition');
  card.style.cssText += '; --sw-offset:-'+SWIPE_W+'px';
  card.style.transform = `translateX(-${SWIPE_W}px)`;
  _activeSwipe = id;
}

function _closeRow(id, immediate){
  const card = document.getElementById('sc-'+id);
  if(!card) return;
  if(immediate) card.classList.add('no-transition');
  else          card.classList.remove('no-transition');
  card.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
  if(_activeSwipe === id) _activeSwipe = null;
  if(immediate) setTimeout(()=>card.classList.remove('no-transition'), 30);
}

function handleCardTap(e, id){
  // If a row is open and user taps the card → close instead of open detail
  if(_activeSwipe === id){
    _closeRow(id, false);
    e.stopPropagation();
    return;
  }
  if(_activeSwipe){
    _closeRow(_activeSwipe, true);
    e.stopPropagation();
    return;
  }
  openDetail(id);
}

function filterItems(){
  const q=document.getElementById('searchInput').value.toLowerCase();
  let items=S.items.filter(i=>{
    const mq=!q||i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)||i.obs.toLowerCase().includes(q);
    const mc=S.catFilter==='all'||i.cat===S.catFilter;
    return mq&&mc;
  });
  const list=document.getElementById('itemsList');
  if(!items.length){
    list.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><div class="big">📦</div><p>Nenhum produto encontrado.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const _firstSwipe = !localStorage.getItem('stoq_sw_seen');
  list.innerHTML=items.map((it,_idx)=>{
    const st=itemStatus(it);
    const thresh=alertThresh(it);
    const pct=thresh>0?Math.min(it.qty/thresh*100,100):100;
    const barColor=it.qty===0?'var(--red)':it.qty<=it.min?'var(--red)':it.qty<=thresh?'var(--yellow)':'var(--accent)';
    const ph=S.photos?S.photos[it.id]:null;
    const icon=ph?`<img class="item-photo-thumb" src="${ph}" alt="">`:`<div class="iitem-icon ${CAT[it.cat].cls}">${it.icon}</div>`;
    const hint=_firstSwipe&&_idx===0?' show-hint':'';
    return `<div class="swipe-row${hint}" id="sr-${it.id}" data-id="${it.id}">
      <div class="swipe-actions">
        <div class="swipe-action sa-in" onclick="swipeQuickMov('in','${it.id}')">

function renderMovs(){
  let movs=[...S.movs].sort((a,b)=>b.ts-a.ts);
  if(S.movFilter==='in')  movs=movs.filter(m=>m.type==='in');
  if(S.movFilter==='out') movs=movs.filter(m=>m.type==='out');
  const list=document.getElementById('movList');
  if(!movs.length){
    list.innerHTML=`<div class="empty"><div class="big">🔄</div><p>Nenhuma movimentação.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML=movs.map(m=>{
    const it=getItem(m.itemId);if(!it)return'';
    return `<div class="mitem">
      <div class="marrow ${m.type}">${m.type==='in'?'▲':'▼'}</div>
      <div class="minfo">
        <div class="mname">${it.icon} ${it.name}</div>
        <div class="mmeta">${m.resp||'—'} · ${fmtDate(m.ts)}${m.obs?' · '+m.obs:''}${m.valor>0?' · '+fmtR(m.valor):''}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mqty ${m.type}">${m.type==='in'?'+':'-'}${m.qty} ${it.unit}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function setMovFilter(f,btn){
  S.movFilter=f;
  document.querySelectorAll('#mtAll,#mtIn,#mtOut').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  renderMovs();
}

function updateThreshLabel(type){
  if(type==='warn'){
    const v=document.getElementById('threshWarn').value;
    document.getElementById('threshWarnLbl').textContent=v+'%';
    S.settings.threshWarn=parseInt(v);
    save();
    updateBanners();
  }
}

function setItemThresh(id,val){
  const idx=S.items.findIndex(i=>i.id===id);
  if(idx===-1)return;
  S.items[idx].thresh=val===''||parseInt(val)===0?null:parseInt(val);
  save();
  updateBanners();
  toast(`Limite de alerta atualizado para ${S.items[idx].name}`,'info');
}

function buildEmojiPicker(){
  document.getElementById('emojiPicker').innerHTML=EMOJIS.map(e=>
    `<div class="eopt ${e===S.selEmoji?'sel':''}" onclick="selEmoji(this,'${e}')">${e}</div>`
  ).join('');
}
function selEmoji(el,e){
  S.selEmoji=e;
  document.querySelectorAll('.eopt').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
  el.classList.add('sel');
}
function openAddModal(){
  S.editId=null; S.selEmoji='📦';
  document.getElementById('modalAddTitle').textContent='Novo Produto';
  document.getElementById('btnDelete').style.display='none';
  ['fName','fQty','fMin','fLoc','fObs','fThresh','fPreco'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value='');
  S._pendingPhoto=undefined;
  _resetPhotoUI();
  document.getElementById('fCat').value='limpeza';
  document.getElementById('fUnit').value='un';
  buildEmojiPicker();
  openModal('modalAdd');
}

function openMovModal(type,itemId){
  document.getElementById('movTitle').textContent=type==='in'?'Registrar Entrada':'Registrar Saída';
  document.getElementById('movType').value=type;
  document.getElementById('movQty').value=1;
  document.getElementById('movResp').value=localStorage.getItem('stoq_resp')||'';
  document.getElementById('movObs').value='';
  document.getElementById('movValor').value='';
  const sel=document.getElementById('movProduct');
  sel.innerHTML=S.items.map(i=>
    `<option value="${i.id}" ${i.id===itemId?'selected':''}>${i.icon} ${i.name} (${i.qty} ${i.unit})</option>`
  ).join('');
  openModal('modalMov');
}
function quickMov(type){
  closeModal('modalDetail');
  setTimeout(()=>openMovModal(type,S.detailId),200);
}
function saveMov(){
  const itemId=document.getElementById('movProduct').value;
  const qty=parseInt(document.getElementById('movQty').value)||0;
  const type=document.getElementById('movType').value;
  const resp=document.getElementById('movResp').value.trim();
  const obs=document.getElementById('movObs').value.trim();
  const valor=parseFloat(document.getElementById('movValor').value)||0;
  if(!qty||qty<1){toast('Quantidade inválida','err');return}
  const idx=S.items.findIndex(i=>i.id===itemId);
  if(idx===-1)return;
  if(type==='out'&&S.items[idx].qty<qty){
    toast(`Estoque insuficiente — disponível: ${S.items[idx].qty} ${S.items[idx].unit}`,'err');
    return;
  }
  S.items[idx].qty+=type==='in'?qty:-qty;
  S.movs.push({id:uid(),itemId,type,qty,resp,obs,valor,ts:Date.now()});
  save();closeModal('modalMov');
  toast(type==='in'?`+${qty} unidades adicionadas`:`-${qty} unidades retiradas`,'ok');
  if(S.screen==='estoque')renderEstoque();
  if(S.screen==='mov')renderMovs();
  updateBanners();

        const checked=S.confChecked[it.id];
        const isAlert=st.level!=='ok';
        return `<div class="conf-item">
          <div class="conf-check ${checked?'checked':''}" onclick="toggleConf('${it.id}')">${checked?'✓':''}</div>
          <div style="flex:1">
            <div class="conf-iname" style="color:${isAlert&&!checked?'var(--yellow)':'inherit'}">${it.icon} ${it.name}${isAlert?` <span style="font-size:10px;color:${st.level==='danger'?'var(--red)':'var(--yellow)'}">⚠ ${st.label}</span>`:''}</div>
            <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono)">${CAT[it.cat].label} · ${it.loc||'sem local'}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="conf-qty ${isAlert?'alert':''}">${it.qty} ${it.unit}</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
}

  S.confChecked[id]=!S.confChecked[id];
  save();renderConfList();
}

// TOAST
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function toast(msg,type='ok'){
  const c=document.getElementById('toastWrap');
  const t=document.createElement('div');
  t.className=`toast ${type}`;
  const icons={ok:'✓',err:'✕',info:'ℹ'};
  t.innerHTML=`<span style="font-size:14px">${icons[type]||'·'}</span><span>${msg}</span>`;
  c.appendChild(t);
  setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),3100);
}

// FAQ

function toggleFaq(qEl){
  const item=qEl.closest('.faq-item');
  const wasOpen=item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('open'));
  if(!wasOpen) item.classList.add('open');
}

// ── Search & add item ─────────────────────
function listaSearchFilter(){
  const q = document.getElementById('listaSearchInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
  const el = document.getElementById('listaSearchResults');
  if(!q){ el.innerHTML=''; return; }
  const matches = S.items.filter(i=>
    i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || CAT[i.cat]?.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)
  ).slice(0,6);
  if(!matches.length){ el.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);padding:8px 10px">Nenhum item encontrado</div>`; return; }
  el.innerHTML = matches.map(it=>{
    const st = itemStatus(it);
    const already = S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===it.id);
    const statusColor = st.level==='danger'?'var(--red)':st.level==='warn'?'var(--yellow)':'var(--green)';
    const statusBg = st.level==='danger'?'var(--red-dim)':st.level==='warn'?'var(--yellow-dim)':'var(--green-dim)';
    return `<div class="lista-search-item" onclick="adicionarNaLista('${it.id}')">
      <span style="font-size:18px">${it.icon}</span>
      <div class="lsi-name">${it.name} <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono)">${it.qty} ${it.unit}</span></div>
      <span class="lsi-status" style="background:${statusBg};color:${statusColor}">${st.label}</span>
      ${already?'<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono)">✓ na lista</span>':''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

// ── Save list ─────────────────────────────
function salvarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const name = prompt('Nome da lista (ex: Compras Março 2025):', 'Lista ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'));
  if(!name) return;
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  S.shoppingLists.unshift({
    id: uid(), name, ts: Date.now(),
    items: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S.currentList)),
    total, notes:''
  });
  if(S.shoppingLists.length > 20) S.shoppingLists.splice(20);
  S.currentList = [];
  save(); renderLista();
  toast(`✓ Lista "${name}" salva`,'ok');
}

function deletarListaHistorico(idx){

}

function atualizarComparacao(){
  const selA = document.getElementById('cmpA');
  const selB = document.getElementById('cmpB');
  if(!selA||!selB) return;
  const idxA = parseInt(selA.value);
  const idxB = parseInt(selB.value);
  if(idxA === idxB){ document.getElementById('cmpResult').innerHTML='<div style="color:var(--text3);font-size:12px;padding:8px">Selecione listas diferentes.</div>'; return; }
  const listA = S.shoppingLists[idxA];
  const listB = S.shoppingLists[idxB];
  const deltaTotal = listA.total - listB.total;
  const deltaPct   = listB.total > 0 ? ((listA.total-listB.total)/listB.total*100).toFixed(1) : 0;
  const deltaClass = deltaTotal > 0 ? 'up' : deltaTotal < 0 ? 'down' : 'same';

  // Union of all item names
  const allNames = [...new Set([...listA.items.map(i=>i.name),...listB.items.map(i=>i.name)])];

  const rows = allNames.map(name=>{
    const a = listA.items.find(i=>i.name===name);
    const b = listB.items.find(i=>i.name===name);
    const qA = a ? a.qty : 0;
    const qB = b ? b.qty : 0;
    const delta = qA - qB;
    const dcls = delta>0?'up':delta<0?'down':'same';
    const dTxt = delta>0?`+${delta}`:delta<0?`${delta}`:'=';
    return `<div class="cmp-row">
      <span style="font-size:12px">${(a||b)?.icon||'📦'} ${name}</span>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
        <span style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text2)">${qA||'—'} vs ${qB||'—'}</span>
        <span class="cmp-delta ${dcls}">${dTxt}</span>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

function pararVoz(){
  _vozActive = false;
  if(_recog){ _recog.stop(); _recog = null; }
  document.getElementById('vozBanner').classList.add('hidden');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btnVoz');
  if(btn){ btn.style.background=''; btn.style.borderColor=''; }
}

function processarVoz(txt){
  const lower = txt.toLowerCase();
  let qty = 1;
  // extract number
  const numMatch = lower.match(/(\d+)/);
  if(numMatch) qty = parseInt(numMatch[1]);
  else {
    for(const [word,val] of Object.entries(NUM_WORDS)){
      if(lower.includes(word)){ qty = val; break; }
    }
  }
  // find best matching item
  const words = lower.replace(/[0-9]/g,'').split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w.length>2);
  let best=null, bestScore=0;
  S.items.forEach(it=>{
    const nameLow = it.name.toLowerCase();
    let score = 0;
    words.forEach(w=>{ if(nameLow.includes(w)) score+=w.length; });
    if(score>bestScore){ bestScore=score; best=it; }
  });
  if(!best || bestScore < 3){ toast(`N
---
bestScore < 3){ toast(`Não reconheci um produto em: "${txt}"`, 'err'); return; }
  // Show confirmation
  mostrarConfirmacaoVoz(best, qty, txt);
}

function _renderRelEstoque(){

  const danger = S.items.filter(i=>itemStatus(i).level==='danger'||i.qty===0).length;

  document.getElementById('relStatCards').innerHTML = `

      </div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:6px">${withPrice}/${total} itens com preço · ${withLoc}/${total} com localização</div>
    </div>
    ${sugs.map(s=>`
      <div class="sug-item">
        <div class="sug-icon" style="background:${s.color}">${s.icon}</div>
        <div class="sug-body">
          <h4>${s.title}</h4>
          <p>${s.body}</p>
          <span class="sug-tag">${s.tag}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('')}
  `;
}

function renderBudgetInputs(){

  if(!el) return;
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  el.innerHTML = Object.entries(CAT).map(([key,cat])=>`

      <div style="flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:500">${cat.label}</div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono)">R$</span>
        <input type="number" class="atr-input" id="budget_${key}" value="${budgets[key]||0}" min="0" step="10" placeholder="0"
          style="width:80px;text-align:right" onchange="previewBudget('${key}')">
      </div>
    </div>`).join('');

}

function previewBudget(key){
  const val = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`budget_${key}`)?.value)||0;
  if(!S.settings.budgets) S.settings.budgets={};
  S.settings.budgets[key] = val;
  renderBudgetBars();
}

function renderPrevisao(){
  const el = document.getElementById('previsaoList');
  if(!el) return;

  const now = Date.now();
  const dias90 = 90 * 86400000;
  const movs90 = S.movs.filter(m=>m.type==='out'&&(now-m.ts)<=dias90);

  if(!movs90.length){
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="empty" style="padding:24px"><div class="big">🔮</div><p>Dados insuficientes.<br>Registre saídas por pelo menos 7 dias.</p></div>`;
    return;
  }

  // Group saídas por item, calcular taxa/dia
  const rates = {};
  movs90.forEach(m=>{
    if(!rates[m.itemId]) rates[m.itemId]={qty:0, firstTs:m.ts, lastTs:m.ts};
    rates[m.itemId].qty += m.qty;
    rates[m.itemId].firstTs = Math.min(rates[m.itemId].firstTs, m.ts);
    rates[m.itemId].lastTs  = Math.max(rates[m.itemId].lastTs, m.ts);
  });

  const predictions = Object.entries(rates)
    .map(([itemId, r])=>{
      const it = getItem(itemId); if(!it) return null;
      const spanDias = Math.max(1, (now - r.firstTs) / 86400000);
      const taxaDia  = r.qty / spanDias;          // unidades/dia
      const diasAteZerar = taxaDia > 0 ? it.qty / taxaDia : 999;
      const qtdRecom30 = Math.ceil(taxaDia * 30);
      const qtdRecom60 = Math.ceil(taxaDia * 60);
      const confianca = spanDias >= 30 ? 'alta' : spanDias >= 14 ? 'média' : 'baixa';
      return { it, taxaDia, diasAteZerar, qtdRecom30, qtdRecom60, confianca, spanDias };
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .filter(p=>p.taxaDia>0)
    .sort((a,b)=>a.diasAteZerar-b.diasAteZerar);

  if(!predictions.length){
    el.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:13px;color:va

function _onSystemChange(e) { applyColorScheme(e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light'); }

function _applyAutoTheme() {
  const h = new Date().getHours();
  applyColorScheme(h >= 19 || h < 7 ? 'dark' : 'light');
}

function applyColorScheme(scheme) {
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', scheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
  if(scheme === 'dark')  document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
}

function toggleThemePop() {
  const pop = document.getElementById('themePop');
  const isOpen = pop.classList.contains('open');
  document.addEventListener('click', _closePop, {once:true, capture:true});
  pop.classList.toggle('open');
  if(isOpen) document.removeEventListener('click', _closePop, true);
}

function closethemePop() {
  document.getElementById('themePop')?.classList.remove('open');
}

function _closePop(e) {
  if(!document.getElementById('btnTheme')?.contains(e.target) &&
     !document.getElementById('themePop')?.contains(e.target)) {
    closethemePop();
  }
}

let _obStep = 0;

function startOnboard(){
  if(localStorage.getItem('stoq_onboard_done')) return;
  _obStep = 0;
  document.getElementById('onboardOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  _renderObStep();
}

function _renderObStep(){
  const s  = OB_STEPS[_obStep];
  const tot = OB_STEPS.length;
  document.getElementById('obIcon').textContent  = s.icon;
  document.getElementById('obTitle').textContent  = s.title;
  document.getElementById('obBody').innerHTML    = s.body;
  document.getElementById('obNext').textContent  = _obStep < tot-1 ? 'Próximo →' : '🚀 Começar!';
  document.getElementById('obSkip').style.display = _obStep===0||_obStep===tot-1 ? 'none' : 'block';
  // Dots
  const dots = document.getElementById('obSteps');
  dots.innerHTML = OB_STEPS.map((_,i)=>
    `<div class="ob-step-dot ${i<_obStep?'done':i===_obStep?'active':''}"></div>`
  ).join('');
  // animate card
  const card = document.getElementById('obCard');
  card.style.animation = 'none';
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ card.style.animation='obIn .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.2,.64,1)'; });
}

function nextOnboard(){
  if(_obStep === OB_STEPS.length-1){
    // Save responsável if entered
    const inp = document.getElementById('obRespInput');
    if(inp && inp.value.trim()){
      localStorage.setItem('stoq_resp', inp.value.trim());
      _updateRespBadge();
    }
    localStorage.setItem('stoq_onboard_done','1');
    document.getElementById('onboardOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
    toast('✓ Configuração concluída — bem-vindo ao Stoq!','ok');
    return;
  }
  _obStep++;
  _renderObStep();
}

function skipOnboard(){
  localStorage.setItem('stoq_onboard_done','1');
  document.getElementById('onboardOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
}

function _showQtyBump(type, name, newQty, unit){
  const old = document.querySelector('.qty-bump');
  if(old) old.remove();
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = `qty-bump ${type}`;
  el.innerHTML = `<span>${type==='in'?'▲':'▼'} ${name}</span><strong>${newQty} ${unit}</strong>`;
  document.body.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(()=>{ el.style.opacity='0'; el.style.transition='opacity .3s'; }, 1600);
  setTimeout(()=>el.remove(), 1950);
}

function deleteItem(){
  if(!confirm('Excluir este produto e todo o histórico?'))return;
  const deletedId=S.editId;
  S.items=S.items.filter(i=>i.id!==deletedId);
  S.movs=S.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId!==deletedId);
  S.currentList=S.currentList.filter(i=>i.itemId!==deletedId);
  delete S.confChecked[deletedId];
  delete S.photos[deletedId];
  save();closeModal('modalAdd');
  toast('Produto excluído','ok');
  if(S.screen==='estoque')renderEstoque();
  updateBanners();renderDashboard();
}

  const payload={id:'stoq-main',items:JSON.stringify(S.items),movs:JSON.stringify(S.movs),settings:JSON.stringify(cloudSettings),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};
  try{
    const res=await fetch(url+'/rest/v1/stoq_backups',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':key,'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Prefer':'resolution=merge-duplicates'},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if(res.ok||res.status===201||res.status===200){
      sbSetStatus('ok'); SP.set('sbUrl',url); SP.set('sbKey',key);
      sbLog('✓ Dados enviados para Supabase!');
      toast('✓ Salvo no Supabase','ok');
    } else {
      const err=await res.text();
      sbLog('Erro '+res.status+': '+err.slice(0,60));
    }
  } catch(e){ sbLog('Erro: '+e.message); toast('Falha no Supabase','err'); }
}

async function syncSBSave(){
  const url=document.getElementById('sbUrl').value.trim().replace(/\/$/,'');
  const key=document.getElementById('sbKey').value.trim();
  if(!url||!key){toast('URL e Key necessários','err');return;}
  sbLog('Enviando para Supabase…');
  const cloudSettings={...S.settings,__stoqBackupExtras:{confChecked:S.confChecked,shoppingLists:S.shoppingLists,currentList:S.currentList,photos:S.photos||{}}};
  const payload={id:'stoq-main',items:JSON.stringify(S.items),movs:JSON.stringify(S.movs),settings:JSON.stringify(cloudSettings),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};
  try{
    const res=await fetch(url+'/rest/v1/stoq_backups',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':key,'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Prefer':'resolution=merge-duplicates'},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if(res.ok||res.status===201||res.status===200){
      sbSetStatus('ok'); SP.set('sbUrl',url); SP.set('sbKey',key);
      sbLog('✓ Dados enviados para Supabase!');
      toast('✓ Salvo no Supabase','ok');
    } else {
      const err=await res.text();
      sbLog('Erro '+res.status+': '+err.slice(0,60));
    }
  } catch(e){ sbLog('Erro: '+e.message); toast('Falha no Supabase','err'); }
}

    const checked = it.checked ? 'on' : '';
    const cls     = it.checked ? 'checked' : '';
    const prioCol = it.priority==='high'?'high':it.priority==='low'?'low':'medium';
    const preco   = it.preco > 0 ? fmtR(it.preco * it.qty) : '—';
    return `<div class="lista-item ${cls}" id="litem-${i}">
      <div class="lista-check ${checked}" onclick="toggleListaItem(${i})">${it.checked?'✓':''}</div>
      <div class="lista-prio ${prioCol}"></div>
      <div class="lista-info">
        <div class="lista-name">${it.icon||'📦'} ${it.name}</div>
        <div class="lista-meta">${CAT[it.cat]?.label||it.cat} · ${it.unit}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="lista-qty-ctrl">
        <button class="qbtn-sm" onclick="listaQty(${i},-1)">−</button>
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-weight:
---
etElementById('listaTabHistorico').style.display = name==='historico' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('listaTabComparar').style.display  = name==='comparar'  ? '' : 'none';
  if(name==='historico') renderHistorico();
  if(name==='comparar')  renderComparar();
}

// ── Save list ─────────────────────────────
function salvarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const name = prompt('Nome da lista (ex: Compras Março 2025):', 'Lista ' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'));
  if(!name) return;
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  S.shoppingLists.unshift({
    id: uid(), name, ts: Date.now(),
    items: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(S.currentList)),
    total, notes:''
  });
  if(S.shoppingLists.length > 20) S.shoppingLists.splice(20);
  S.currentList = [];
  save(); renderLista();
  toast(`✓ Lista "${name}" salva`,'ok');
}

// ── Export list ───────────────────────────
function exportarLista(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const lines = ['LISTA DE COMPRAS — Stoq','Gerada em: '+new Date().toLocaleString('pt-BR'),'─'.repeat(40),''];
  S.currentList.forEach(it=>{
    const checked = it.checked ? '[✓]' : '[ ]';
    lines.push(`${checked} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}${it.preco>0?' (est. '+fmtR(it.preco*it.qty)+')':''}`);
  });
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  lines.push('','─'.repeat(40));
  lines.push('Total estimado: '+fmtR(total));
  const blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/plain;charset=utf-8'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'lista-compras-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.txt';
  a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  toast('Lista exportada','ok');
}

function verListaHistorico(idx){
  const lst = S.shoppingLists[idx];
  const lines = lst.items.map(it=>`${it.checked?'[✓]':'[ ]'} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}`).join('\n');

}

function deletarListaHistorico(idx){
  if(!confirm('Excluir esta lista do histórico?')) return;
  S.shoppingLists.splice(idx,1);
  save(); renderHistorico();
  toast('Lista excluída','ok');
}

function verListaHistorico(idx){
  const lst = S.shoppingLists[idx];
  const lines = lst.items.map(it=>`${it.checked?'[✓]':'[ ]'} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}`).join('\n');
  const total = fmtR(lst.total);
  alert(`📋 ${lst.name}\n${'─'.repeat(36)}\n${lines}\n${'─'.repeat(36)}\nTotal estimado: ${total}`);
}

  try { S.movs     = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_movs')  || '[]'); } catch(e){ S.movs=[]; }
  try { S.settings = {...S.settings,...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_set') || '{}')}; } catch(e){}
  try { S.confChecked = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_conf') || '{}'); } catch(e){}
  try { S.shoppingLists = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_lists') || '[]'); } catch(e){}
  try { S.currentList = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_clist') || '[]'); } catch(e){}
  try { S.photos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ec2_photos') || '{}'); } catch(e){ S.photos={}; }
  if (localStorage.getItem('ec2_items') === null) seedData();
}

  save();

function applyOperationalSnapshot(d) {
  if(!validateOperationalSnapshot(d)) throw new Error('Estrutura de backup inválida');
  S.items=d.items;
  S.movs=d.movs;
  S.settings={...S.settings,...d.settings};
  if(Array.isArray(d.shoppingLists)) S.shoppingLists=d.shoppingLists;
  if(Array.isArray(d.currentList)) S.currentList=d.currentList;
  if(d.photos && typeof d.photos==='object' && !Array.isArray(d.photos)) S.photos=d.photos;
  if(d.confChecked && typeof d.confChecked==='object' && !Array.isArray(d.confChecked)) S.confChecked=d.confChecked;
  save();
}

function deleteItem(){
  if(!confirm('Excluir este produto e todo o histórico?'))return;
  const deletedId=S.editId;
  S.items=S.items.filter(i=>i.id!==deletedId);
  S.movs=S.movs.filter(m=>m.itemId!==deletedId);
  S.currentList=S.currentList.filter(i=>i.itemId!==deletedId);
  delete S.confChecked[deletedId];
  delete S.photos[deletedId];
  save();closeModal('modalAdd');
  toast('Produto excluído','ok');
  if(S.screen==='estoque')renderEstoque();
  updateBanners();renderDashboard();
}

async function syncSBSave(){
  const url=document.getElementById('sbUrl').value.trim().replace(/\/$/,'');
  const key=document.getElementById('sbKey').value.trim();
  if(!url||!key){toast('URL e Key necessários','err');return;}
  sbLog('Enviando para Supabase…');
  const cloudSettings={...S.settings,__stoqBackupExtras:{confChecked:S.confChecked,shoppingLists:S.shoppingLists,currentList:S.currentList,photos:S.photos||{}}};
  const payload={id:'stoq-main',items:JSON.stringify(S.items),movs:JSON.stringify(S.movs),settings:JSON.stringify(cloudSettings),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()};
  try{
    const res=await fetch(url+'/rest/v1/stoq_backups',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','apikey':key,'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Prefer':'resolution=merge-duplicates'},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    if(res.ok||res.status===201||res.status===200){
      sbSetStatus('ok'); SP.set('sbUrl',url); SP.set('sbKey',key);
      sbLog('✓ Dados enviados para Supabase!');
      toast('✓ Salvo no Supabase','ok');
    } else {
      const err=await res.text();
      sbLog('Erro '+res.status+': '+err.slice(0,60));
    }
  } catch(e){ sbLog('Erro: '+e.message); toast('Falha no Supabase','err'); }
}

// ── Badge ─────────────────────────────────
function updateListaBadge(){
  const n = S.currentList.filter(i=>!i.checked).length;
  const b = document.getElementById('badgeLista');
  if(b){ b.style.display = n ? 'flex' : 'none'; b.textContent = n > 9 ? '9+' : n; }
}

// ── Tab switching ─────────────────────────
let _listaTab = 'atual';
function setListaTab(name, btn){
  _listaTab = name;
  document.querySelectorAll('#ltAtual,#ltHistorico,#ltComparar').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('listaTabAtual').style.display    = name==='atual'     ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('listaTabHistorico').style.display = name==='historico' ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('listaTabComparar').style.display  = name==='comparar'  ? '' : 'none';
  if(name==='historico') renderHistorico();
  if(name==='comparar')  renderComparar();
}

// ── Render current list ───────────────────
function renderLista(){
  updateListaBadge();
  renderListaItens();
  renderListaResumo();
  document.getElementById('listaSubtitle').textContent =
    S.shoppingLists.length ? `${S.shoppingLists.length} lista${S.shoppingLists.length>1?'s':''} salva${S.shoppingLists.length>1?'s':''}` : 'Gerencie e compare suas listas';
}

function renderListaItens(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaItens');
  const vazio = document.getElementById('listaVazia');
  if(!S.currentList.length){
    el.innerHTML = '';
    vazio.style.display = '';

  vazio.style.display = 'none';
  el.innerHTML = S.currentList.map((it,i)=>{
    const checked = it.checked ? 'on' : '';

    const prioCol = it.priority==='high'?'high':it.priority==='low'?'low':'medium';
    const preco   = it.preco > 0 ? fmtR(it.preco * it.qty) : '—';
    return `<div class="lista-item ${cls}" id="litem-${i}">

      <div class="lista-info">
        <div class="lista-name">${it.icon||'📦'} ${it.name}</div>

      </div>
      <div class="lista-qty-ctrl">
        <button class="qbtn-sm" onclick="listaQty(${i},-1)">−</button>
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-weight:700;min-width:28px;text-align:center;color:var(--accent)">${it.qty}</div>
        <button class="qbtn-sm" onclick="listaQty(${i},+1)">+</button>
      </div>
      <div class="lista-right">
        <div class="lista-qty">${it.unit}</div>
        <div class="lista-preco">${preco}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="lista-del" onclick="removerListaItem(${i})">×</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function renderListaResumo(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaResumo');
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('listaTotal');
  const metaEl  = document.getElementById('listaResumoItens');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('listaCount');
  if(!S.currentList.length){ el.style.display='none'; countEl.textContent=''; return; }
  el.style.display='';
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  totalEl.textContent = fmtR(total);
  metaEl.textContent  = `${S.currentList.length} itens · ${checked} marcados`;
  countEl.textContent = `(${S.currentList.length})`;
}

// ── Toggle item check ─────────────────────
function toggleListaItem(i){
  S.currentList[i].checked = !S.currentList[i].checked;
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
}

// ── Adjust quantity ───────────────────────
function listaQty(i, delta){
  const it = S.currentList[i];
  it.qty = Math.max(1, (it.qty||1) + delta);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo();
}

// ── Remove item ───────────────────────────
function removerListaItem(i){
  S.currentList.splice(i,1);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
  if(!S.currentList.length) document.getElementById('listaVazia').style.display='';
}

// ── Clear list ────────────────────────────
function limparLista(){
  if(!confirm('Limpar lista atual?')) return;
  S.currentList = [];
  save(); renderLista();
}

function renderListaResumo(){
  const el = document.getElementById('listaResumo');
  const totalEl = document.getElementById('listaTotal');
  const metaEl  = document.getElementById('listaResumoItens');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('listaCount');
  if(!S.currentList.length){ el.style.display='none'; countEl.textContent=''; return; }
  el.style.display='';
  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  totalEl.textContent = fmtR(total);
  metaEl.textContent  = `${S.currentList.length} itens · ${checked} marcados`;
  countEl.textContent = `(${S.currentList.length})`;
}

// ── Toggle item check ─────────────────────
function toggleListaItem(i){
  S.currentList[i].checked = !S.currentList[i].checked;
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
}

// ── Adjust quantity ───────────────────────
function listaQty(i, delta){
  const it = S.currentList[i];
  it.qty = Math.max(1, (it.qty||1) + delta);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo();
}

// ── Remove item ───────────────────────────
function removerListaItem(i){
  S.currentList.splice(i,1);
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
  if(!S.currentList.length) document.getElementById('listaVazia').style.display='';
}

// ── Auto-generate from alerts ─────────────
function autoGerarLista(){
  const alerts = S.items.filter(it=>itemStatus(it).level!=='ok');
  if(!alerts.length){ toast('Nenhum item em alerta para gerar lista','info'); return; }
  let added = 0;
  alerts.forEach(it=>{
    if(S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===it.id)) return;
    const needed = Math.max(1, it.min - it.qty + Math.ceil(it.min * 0.3));
    S.currentList.push({
      itemId:it.id, name:it.name, icon:it.icon, cat:it.cat,
      unit:it.unit, qty:needed, preco:it.preco||0, checked:false,
      priority: it.qty===0||it.qty<=it.min ? 'high' : 'medium'
    });
    added++;
  });
  save();
  if(document.getElementById('screen-lista').classList.contains('active')){
    setListaTab('atual', document.getElementById('ltAtual'));
    renderLista();
  }
  toast(`⚡ ${added} item${added>1?'s adicionados':'adicionado'} à lista`,'ok');
}

function listaSearchFilter(){

  const el = document.getElementById('listaSearchResults');

  const matches = S.items.filter(i=>

  el.innerHTML = matches.map(it=>{
    const st = itemStatus(it);
    const already = S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===it.id);
    const statusColor = st.level==='danger'?'var(--red)':st.level==='warn'?'var(--yellow)':'var(--green)';
    const statusBg = st.level==='danger'?

  const el = document.getElementById('listaSearchResults');

    i.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || CAT[i.cat]?.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)
  ).slice(0,6);
  if(!matches.length){ el.innerHTML=`<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text3);padding:8px 10px">Nenhum item encontrado</div>`; return; }

      ${already?'<span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono)">✓ na lista</span>':''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function adicionarNaLista(itemId){
  const it = S.items.find(i=>i.id===itemId);
  if(!it) return;
  const existing = S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===itemId);
  if(existing){ existing.qty++; toast(`+1 ${it.name}`,'ok'); }
  else {
    const needed = Math.max(1, it.min - it.qty + 1);

function adicionarNaLista(itemId){
  const it = S.items.find(i=>i.id===itemId);
  if(!it) return;
  const existing = S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===itemId);
  if(existing){ existing.qty++; toast(`+1 ${it.name}`,'ok'); }
  else {
    const needed = Math.max(1, it.min - it.qty + 1);
    S.currentList.push({
      itemId:it.id, name:it.name, icon:it.icon, cat:it.cat,
      unit:it.unit, qty:needed, preco:it.preco||0, checked:false, priority:'medium'
    });
    toast(`✓ ${it.name} adicionado`,'ok');
  }
  document.getElementById('listaSearchInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('listaSearchResults').innerHTML = '';
  save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
  document.getElementById('listaVazia').style.display='none';
}

function vozAjustarQty(delta, itemId){
  const el = document.getElementById('vozQty');
  if(!el) return;
  const cur = parseInt(el.textContent)||1;
  el.textContent = Math.max(1, cur+delta);
}

function confirmarVoz(itemId){
  const qty = parseInt(document.getElementById('vozQty')?.textContent)||1;
  adicionarNaLista(itemId);
  // fix qty
  const l = S.currentList.find(i=>i.itemId===itemId);
  if(l){ l.qty = qty; save(); renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); }
  document.getElementById('vozConfirmArea')?.remove();
  toast(`✓ Adicionado por voz (${qty} un)`, 'ok');
}

function cancelarVoz(){
  document.getElementById('vozConfirmArea')?.remove();
}

function setRelTab(name, btn){
  _relTab = name;
  document.querySelectorAll('#rtEstoque,#rtMovs,#rtFinanceiro').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));

  document.getElementById('relTabMovs').style.display       = name==='movs'       ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('relTabFinanceiro').style.display = name==='financeiro'  ? '' : 'none';
  setTimeout(()=>_renderRelTab(name), 60);
}

// WHATSAPP SHARE
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function compartilharWhatsApp(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const data = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  let msg = `📋 *Lista de Compras — Stoq*\n📅 ${data}\n${'─'.repeat(30)}\n\n`;

  // Group by category
  const byCat = {};
  S.currentList.forEach(it=>{
    const catKey = it.cat||'outros';
    if(!byCat[catKey]) byCat[catKey]=[];
    byCat[catKey].push(it);
  });
  Object.entries(byCat).forEach(([cat,items])=>{
    const catInfo = CAT[cat]||{emoji:'📦',label:cat};
    msg += `*${catInfo.emoji} ${catInfo.label}*\n`;
    items.forEach(it=>{
      const chk = it.checked ? '✅' : '⬜';
      const est = it.preco>0 ? ` _(est. ${fmtR(it.preco*it.qty)})_` : '';
      msg += `${chk} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}${est}\n`;
    });
    msg += '\n';
  });

  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  msg += `${'─'.repeat(30)}\n`;
  msg += `📦 *${S.currentList.length} itens* · ✅ ${checked} marcados\n`;
  if(total>0) msg += `💰 *Total estimado: ${fmtR(total)}*\n`;
  msg += `\n_Gerado pelo Stoq_`;

  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(msg);
  const url = `https://wa.me/?text=${encoded}`;
  window.open(url, '_blank');
  toast('Abrindo WhatsApp…','
---
; URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  toast('CSV exportado','ok');
}

function compartilharWhatsApp(){
  if(!S.currentList.length){ toast('Lista vazia','err'); return; }
  const data = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
  let msg = `📋 *Lista de Compras — Stoq*\n📅 ${data}\n${'─'.repeat(30)}\n\n`;

  // Group by category
  const byCat = {};
  S.currentList.forEach(it=>{
    const catKey = it.cat||'outros';
    if(!byCat[catKey]) byCat[catKey]=[];
    byCat[catKey].push(it);
  });
  Object.entries(byCat).forEach(([cat,items])=>{
    const catInfo = CAT[cat]||{emoji:'📦',label:cat};
    msg += `*${catInfo.emoji} ${catInfo.label}*\n`;
    items.forEach(it=>{
      const chk = it.checked ? '✅' : '⬜';
      const est = it.preco>0 ? ` _(est. ${fmtR(it.preco*it.qty)})_` : '';
      msg += `${chk} ${it.qty} ${it.unit} — ${it.name}${est}\n`;
    });
    msg += '\n';
  });

  const total = S.currentList.reduce((s,i)=>s+(i.preco>0?i.preco*i.qty:0),0);
  const checked = S.currentList.filter(i=>i.checked).length;
  msg += `${'─'.repeat(30)}\n`;
  msg += `📦 *${S.currentList.length} itens* · ✅ ${checked} marcados\n`;
  if(total>0) msg += `💰 *Total estimado: ${fmtR(total)}*\n`;
  msg += `\n_Gerado pelo Stoq_`;

  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(msg);
  const url = `https://wa.me/?text=${encoded}`;
  window.open(url, '_blank');
  toast('Abrindo WhatsApp…','ok');
}

function renderBudgetInputs(){
  const el = document.getElementById('budgetInputs');
  if(!el) return;
  const budgets = S.settings.budgets||{};
  el.innerHTML = Object.entries(CAT).map(([key,cat])=>`
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)">
      <div style="width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--surface3)">${cat.emoji}</div>
      <div style="flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:500">${cat.label}</div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);font-family:var(--mono)">R$</span>
        <input type="number" class="atr-input" id="budget_${key}" value="${budgets[key]||0}" min="0" step="10" placeholder="0"
          style="
---
out'&&(now-m.ts)<=dias90);
  const rates = {};
  movs90.forEach(m=>{
    if(!rates[m.itemId]) rates[m.itemId]={qty:0,firstTs:m.ts};
    rates[m.itemId].qty+=m.qty;
    rates[m.itemId].firstTs=Math.min(rates[m.itemId].firstTs,m.ts);
  });
  let predicted=0;
  Object.entries(rates).forEach(([itemId,r])=>{
    const it=getItem(itemId); if(!it) return;
    const span=Math.max(1,(now-r.firstTs)/86400000);
    const taxa=r.qty/span;
    const dias=taxa>0?it.qty/taxa:999;
    if(dias<=15&&dias<999&&!S.currentList.find(l=>l.itemId===itemId)){
      S.currentList.push({
        itemId:it.id,name:it.name,icon:it.icon,cat:it.cat,
        unit:it.unit,qty:Math.ceil(taxa*30),preco:it.preco||0,checked:false,priority:'high'
      });
      predicted++;
    }
  });
  if(predicted>0){
    save();
    toast(`🔮 +${predicted} item${predicted>1?'s':''} por previsão de demanda`,'info');
    renderListaItens(); renderListaResumo(); updateListaBadge();
    document.getElementById('listaVazia').style.display='none';
  }
}
// Override after load
window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{
  const origBtn = document.querySelector('[onclick="autoGerarListaComPrevisao()"]');
  if(origBtn) origBtn.setAttribute('onclick','autoGerarListaComPrevisao()');
});
